items.text:
Ostranauts é um jogo divertido, contudo ainda precisa de grandes melhorias em algumas áreas críticas ao meu ver, algumas técnicas, e algumas em termos de gameplay/conteúdo. Eu definitivamente vejo potêncial nesse jogo se tornar algo similar a Rimworld misturado com The Expanse, mas ainda há bastante a ser feito. Por isso gostaria de deixar uma review neutra mas como não é uma opção, vou deixar recomendado pois acretido que tudo isso abaixo pode ser consertado com tempo.

Alguns dos problemas que vejo com o jogo:

* As mecanicas de construção do jogo são um tanto o quanto limitadas. Em específico, não parece ser possível construir algo/colocar uma tarefa de construção num lugar onde um dos seus tripulantes não está vendo. Ou seja, é necessário as vezes colocar alguém dentro de uma sala apenas para poder colocar as ordens de construção desejadas. Basicamente uma mecânica de neblina de guerra/fog of war, algo perfeitamente normal numa situação de combate e tudo mais, contudo, fora destas situações (ex: parado num porto, ou flutuando no espaço sem ninguém por perto) ela simplesmente torna construção bem mais lenta do que deveria ser.

* A inteligência artifical dos NPCs e tripulantes é questionável. Tanto as mecanicas de chat com NPCs para formar amizades/recrutamento/etc, assim como das naves dos NPCs que aparentemente aceleram/desaceleram extremamente rápido (tipo acelerar 10KM/s em questões de segundos). Acompanhei um youtuber jogando uma versão pre-lançamento do jogo e isso parece ter sido melhorado na versão lançada, mas ainda perto dos portos é comum ver isso.

* As tarefas de hauling não são nada eficientes, quase nunca faz sentido usar elas. Por exemplo, se você quer transportar 50x pisos de uma nave sucata para dentro da sua, os tripulantes vão pegar 5x-10x pisos por vez ao invés de encher seu inventário. Supostamente tem mods que consertam isso, mas o jogo foi atualizado e os mods ainda não foram atualizados para ser compativeis novamente. Também não tem nenhuma ordem de "pegar tudo" solto em uma area para o inventário, o que seria melhor em alguns cenários. Tipo deixar o hauling para coisas grandes demais para mochila/carrinho e um pegar tudo para o resto.

* Não é possível agendar tarefas, tipo clicar para um personagem fazer algo, e depois shift+click para ele andar para outro lugar após. As ordens do jogo são úteis para coisas que você faz em massa, mas para um micro-gerenciamento estilo Rimworld não são suficientes.

* A ordem de execução das ordens é bem tosca, e claramente ele vare sequencialmente cada tile, de cima para baixo, executando as tarefas que ele encontra e consegue fazer, e depois prosseguindo para a próxima tile para direita. Não tem qualquer tipo de preferencia por proximidade ou similar. Isso não seria um problema tão grande, até você considerar que cada vez que um tripulante entra/sai da nave você vai perder um pouco de atmosfera para o espaço, e essa ordem de execução de cima->baixo meio que maximiza o numero de abre/fecha das suas portas pois a airlock principal fica no meio da tela e tudo mais. É algo simples de resolver em termos de programação, basta adicionar um peso de proximidade e/ou um offset no valor de preferencia de uma tarfefa quando ela involve cruzar uma airlock.

* O ponto assima também se manifesta ao minerar, onde o tripulante vai parar de continuar a cavar um túnel após quebrar um bloco, e iniciar a cavar uma outra tile que você marcou. Isso pois ao fazer um túnel o os tiles/blocos alcançáveis são feitos, e então quando ele termina ele não verifica se blocos adjacentes agora são alcançáveis, e, portanto, marca a tarefa como inacançável temporariamente e vai minerar outra ordem que você marcou. Basicamente forçando a pessoa a marcar somente uma linha de mineração por vez.

*  Não sei ao certo se é um problema do jogo em sí, mas ao menos jogando no Linux através do Proton ele parece ter um vazamento gradual de memória. Tenho um PC com 32GB de RAM, e jogando normalmente com desempenho bom por algumas horas ele eventualmente vai consumindo mais e mais RAM até que eventualmente é morto por falta de memória. Não culpo o jogo por isso necessáriamente pois não sei se é algum problema da camada de compatibilidade Proton.
items.text_zh:
Ostranauts 是一款有趣的游戏，不过在我看来，它仍然需要在一些关键领域进行重大改进，有些是技术方面的，有些是玩法/内容方面的。我绝对看到了这款游戏有潜力成为类似 Rimworld 与 The Expanse 混合体的东西，但还有很多工作要做。因此我想留下一份中立的评测，但既然这不是一个选项，我会留下推荐，因为我相信下面所有这些都可以随着时间得到修复。

我看到的游戏一些问题：

* 游戏的建造机制有些受限。具体来说，似乎无法在你的某个船员看不到的地方建造东西/放置建造任务。也就是说，有时必须把某人放进一个房间，仅仅是为了能够下达想要的建造命令。基本上就是一种战争迷雾机制，这在战斗等情况下完全正常，然而，在这些情况之外（例如：停靠在港口，或漂浮在太空中附近无人），它只会让建造变得比本该有的速度慢得多。

* NPC 和船员的 AI 值得怀疑。无论是与 NPC 聊天以建立友谊/招募等机制，还是 NPC 飞船似乎会极快地加速/减速（比如在几秒内加速 10KM/s）。我关注过一个 youtuber 玩这款游戏的预发布版本，这在发布版本中似乎有所改善，但在港口附近仍然很常见。

* 搬运任务一点也不高效，几乎从来都不值得使用它们。例如，如果你想从一艘废船上把 50x 地板运到你的船里，船员会一次拿 5x-10x 地板，而不是填满自己的库存。据说有 mod 可以修复这个问题，但游戏更新了，而 mod 还没有更新到再次兼容。也没有任何“全部拾取”散落在一个区域里的东西到库存的命令，这在某些场景下会更好。比如把搬运留给背包/推车装不下的太大东西，而用一个全部拾取来处理其余的东西。

* 无法安排任务，比如点击让一个角色做某事，然后 shift+点击让他在之后走到另一个地方。游戏的命令对于你批量做的事情很有用，但对于 Rimworld 风格的微观管理来说还不够。

* 命令的执行顺序相当粗糙，而且很明显它会从上到下依次遍历每个 tile，执行它遇到且能做的任务，然后继续到右边下一个 tile。它没有任何按距离远近或类似方式的偏好。这本来不会是个太大的问题，直到你考虑到每次一个船员进出飞船，你都会损失一点大气到太空中，而这种从上到下的执行顺序在某种程度上最大化了你的门开/关次数，因为主气闸位于屏幕中间等等。从编程角度来说这很容易解决，只需在任务涉及穿过气闸时添加一个距离权重和/或对任务偏好值加一个偏移。

* 上面这一点在采矿时也会表现出来，船员在打破一个方块后会停止继续挖一条隧道，并开始挖你标记的另一个 tile。这是因为在挖隧道时，可到达的 tiles/方块会被处理，然后当他完成时，他不会检查相邻方块现在是否可到达，因此暂时把任务标记为不可到达，并去挖你标记的另一个命令。基本上就是强迫人一次只标记一条采矿线。

* 我不确定这到底是不是游戏本身的问题，但至少在 Linux 上通过 Proton 玩时，它似乎有逐渐的内存泄漏。我有一台 32GB RAM 的 PC，正常玩且性能良好几个小时后，它最终会消耗越来越多的 RAM，直到最终因内存不足而被杀死。我不一定因此责怪游戏，因为我不知道这是不是 Proton 兼容层的问题。

items.text:
TLDR:   It is fun to me, so I recommend it.

There are design decisions i disagree with and some wasted potential. The controls and mechanics can feel clunky and there is the occasional bug / insufficient optimisation. It is clear that the game has grown over time and that the underlying architecture isn't as clean as it could be.... HOWEVER the game itself is fun, interesting and has a unique charm. It let me rip apart dozens of wrecks to overhaul and "upgrade" my own ship into the abomination of a space-brick it is today. It is one of the games where I wish there was more content to it, though given my playtime that is probably pretty pointless to say.

There are two issues that still bother me though:
1. The world (stations, ships, npcs) does not really feel alive. The npcs and their mission feel arbitrarily randomised and the stations I visited were somewhat of a let down.
2. The progression is off. You can stay around the starting area and pretty much find (almost) all types of shipparts and machines. I did not anticipate being able to spoil the late-game enjoyment of the game by "overgrinding" the starter area. Which is kind of on me, but I would have loved to know. This would be an easy fix by adding vendors and wrecks unique to other areas.... also I feel like there should be more machine-variations in general with different optimised stats. Because planning and experimenting with different parts to redo your ships design YET ANOTHER TIME is what is fun... at least to me.

The developer is active and listening and the game is being worked on. I am looking forward to future changes and even dare to hope for some of my current concerns to be eventually invalidated (which is a rare thing for me to say nowadays).
items.text_zh:
TLDR：对我来说很好玩，所以我推荐它。

有些设计决定我不同意，也有一些被浪费的潜力。操作和机制有时会感觉笨拙，偶尔还有bug/优化不足。很明显这个游戏是随着时间发展起来的，底层架构也没有它本可以有的那么干净……然而游戏本身很好玩、有趣，而且有一种独特的魅力。它让我拆解了几十艘残骸，来彻底翻修并“升级”我自己的飞船，变成今天这个太空砖头般的怪物。这是那种我希望它有更多内容的游戏之一，不过考虑到我的游玩时长，这么说大概也没什么意义。

不过还有两个问题仍然困扰我：
1. 这个世界（空间站、飞船、NPC）并不真的感觉是活的。NPC和他们的任务感觉是随意随机生成的，我去过的空间站也有点让人失望。
2. 进度曲线不对。你可以待在起始区域附近，就几乎能找到（差不多）所有类型的飞船部件和机器。我没想到自己会因为在新手区“过度刷”而破坏游戏后期的乐趣。这某种程度上是我自己的问题，但我本来很想知道这一点。这其实很容易修复，只要给其他区域添加独特的商人和残骸就行……另外我觉得总体上应该有更多机器变体，带有不同的优化属性。因为规划并试验不同部件，再一次重做你的飞船设计，才是有趣的地方……至少对我来说是这样。

开发者很活跃，也在倾听，游戏还在继续开发中。我期待未来的改动，甚至敢于希望我目前的一些担忧最终会变得不再成立（如今我很少会这么说）。

observations.description: 进度失衡，在起始区域就能找到几乎所有类型的飞船部件和机器，可能破坏后期乐趣。
observations.evidence: The progression is off. You can stay around the starting area and pretty much find (almost) all types of shipparts and machines.
observations.evidence_zh: 进度曲线不对劲。你可以待在起始区域附近，就几乎能找到（几乎）所有类型的飞船部件和机器。

items.text:
I want to recommend it, but I can't.

The game is simply unfinished, it is an insult to a proper 1.0 version.

Tons of desperately needed QoL is simply non-existent which makes the gameplay often a chore or mess.

Mechanics aren't properly thought out. Especially the fire hazard at the starting stage is just... a mess still.

The simulation speed will crawl to a halt if you got any larger-scale ship going with multiple work orders.

Your character stops doing tasks as the most fundamental systems like the priority queue are badly designed.

The NPC interactions are extremely barebones, barely anything matters, despite it being such a massive complex system... it has basically zero effect for anything.

Everything is completely 'detached' from each other. Outside of curiosity there is plainly spoken no reason to ever leave the starting area and you don't even get any nudge gameplay wise to follow storylines, they just 'happen' at best or are missed entirely.

For a sandbox on the other hand it is vastly too limited. Making stations is nearly untenable, having NPCs deal with their own needs leads to dead NPCs, all the automated things one would expect for a crew to actually manage? They don't do properly, while regularly getting stuck in endless loops leading to their death for one reason or another.

No, absolutely don't buy, while the game idea is FANTASTIC, and it having all the necessary core aspects to make it a great game or even a masterpiece... it is all unfinished, making it solely 'sub-par'.
items.text_zh:
我想推荐它，但我不能。

这游戏就是没做完，这是对一个正经1.0版本的侮辱。

大量急需的生活质量改进根本就不存在，这让玩法常常变成苦差事或一团糟。

机制没有经过妥善思考。尤其是起始阶段的火灾隐患，还是……一团糟。

如果你让任何较大规模的飞船带着多个工作订单运转，模拟速度就会慢到停滞。

由于像优先级队列这样最基本的系统设计得很糟糕，你的角色会停止执行任务。

NPC互动极其简陋，几乎什么都不重要，尽管它是一个如此庞大复杂的系统……它对任何事情基本上都零影响。

一切都完全彼此‘脱节’。除了好奇心之外，直白地说，根本没有理由离开起始区域，而且你在玩法上也得不到任何推动去追随剧情线，它们充其量只是‘发生’，要么就完全被错过。

另一方面，作为一个沙盒，它又太过局限。建造空间站几乎难以为继，让NPC处理自己的需求会导致NPC死亡，人们期望船员能够妥善管理的所有自动化事项呢？他们做不好，同时还经常陷入无尽循环，因这样或那样的原因导致死亡。

不，绝对不要买，虽然这游戏的点子棒极了，而且它具备所有必要的核心要素，足以让它成为一款伟大的游戏甚至杰作……但这一切都没做完，使它仅仅只是‘平庸’。

observations.evidence: Especially the fire hazard at the starting stage is just... a mess still.
observations.evidence_zh: 尤其是起始阶段的火灾隐患，还是……一团糟。

observations.description: 建造空间站几乎不可行
observations.evidence: Making stations is nearly untenable
observations.evidence_zh: 建造空间站几乎难以为继

items.text:
我是56人民币买的，开发者蓝瓶的大名还是在好几年前玩末日拾荒者的时候知道的，冲着开发者买的，结果玩了47小时感觉不太对劲。
首先现在这个是一款“太空模拟游戏”，而且确实没有官方中文，大家想要中文的话一定要在创意工坊订阅中文化mod，但是mod还是会有缺字和未翻译部分，这个没办法，mod制作者也很难修改。
作为太空模拟游戏，和末日拾荒者比，最大的不同就是没有“制作”功能了，虽然游戏里也有很多种材料，但是通常是用来卖钱或者维修，我们没办法从零开始建造东西，只能用各种零件修复损坏的东西。
而且太空拾荒者，真的是围绕太空飞船展开：开局我们有一艘破飞船，需要开着我们的破飞船去其他更破的飞船上打捞各种配件卖钱，开的过程相当硬核，非常建议大家到B站上找一下介绍视频。当然赚钱也可以做各种小任务，而且赚的更多。
钱赚够了，我们就要从其他的破飞船上拆下各种部件加装到我们的飞船上，建设一艘最大最强的飞船。
然后大家可以跟着steam指南里的剧情流程攻略，做一下流程任务，解锁一下成就。
再然后就没有什么了，说实话玩了这么久，就是想看看剧情，结果被一堆文字糊脸，也就是太空时代利益纠葛那些事，我们主角就是个可怜的普通人（兼职黑客大师和海盗头子）。
而且这游戏优化挺差的，玩久了每次存读档都要一大堆现实时间，而且飞船大了之后，被别的飞船打，或者核反应堆爆炸，或者什么大规模爆炸，你就等着自己卡成PPT吧。
本来是作为环世界的代餐玩的，现在还是回去玩环世界吧。
————————————————
追加，现在再次觉得，ostranauts太空拾荒者的技能系统和战斗系统属于根本没有，全部的游戏过程就是拆船-赚钱-拆船-赚钱，玩久了真的很乏味。之前的末日拾荒者属于也是没有技能系统的那一种，但是战斗系统挺有意思的，还可以制作点小玩意，太空拾荒者真的除了画面进步，其他的啥都没有感觉。。。

items.text: I followed it a bit on social media and thought it looked quite interesting, but when I saw how complicated some of the systems were, I decided to return the product instead. Things are unnecessarily complicated; it really needs a redesign. Sure, some people are into that sort of thing, but you can't expect someone to get a degree just to play a game.
items.text_zh: 我在社交媒体上稍微关注过它，觉得看起来挺有意思的，但当我看到有些系统有多复杂时，我决定退货。事情被搞得没必要地复杂；它真的需要重新设计。当然，有些人喜欢那种东西，但你不能指望别人为了玩一款游戏去拿个学位。

observations.description: 系统过于复杂，需要重新设计

items.text: 很折磨啊，刚开始的几个小时储存空间给的很少，一个拖车基本上船里没空间了，补给站里背包也少刷。开局打工任务又有很多要跑很远的前期根本没法做的任务，要么就是反复的刷k站内的一趟一两千的快递任务。拆船拆出来的部件一般占地巨大，塞不进储物箱船上也没地放，正常的思维当然是直接卖掉吧，结果这些垃圾可以在k站里随地乱放不会消失，留着修船塞到房间里才赚的多点。这时候跑去外面想拆船拆点墙和地板出来扩建船和修船骸居然不能直接下多个命令，要我一个一个点。战斗根据天赋来要么疲劳攻击到高二氧化碳要么三拳打死镇关西。对话交流选项那么多，聊几轮下来感觉也压根没什么变化。路上想上npc的船随便上，压根不会跑，把npc船上东西全拆了也没半点反应。看着全是细节，实际上是百疏一密。

items.text:
[b]I really want to like this game, but for me it falls short of delivering a compelling derelict-exploration experience.[/b]

The core loop of exploring derelicts becomes repetitive, largely risk-free and lacking in tension. Within a few moments of boarding a derelict, you generally have a very good idea of how dangerous it is. There seems to be a very limited set of risks, and information about what to expect is obtained almost immediately rather than through a prolonged process of uncertainty, investigation and risk-versus-reward decision-making. If you have a thermal visor, you can even detect the heat of a human onboard with absolute certainty without being in the same room and separated by walls and closed doors (x-ray vision).

Although the game simulates pressure, atmosphere, temperature, fire and equipment condition, I have encountered almost no emergent environmental hazards during routine derelict exploration that actually require diagnosis, preparation or adaptation. Shipbreaking itself is generally uneventful: choose the appropriate interaction and wait for something to be dismantled, repaired or removed.

The lack of a substantial procedural space-horror element in routine exploration is also disappointing. There is enormous potential here for something drawing on Alien, Pandorum or Event Horizon, and its absence feels particularly strange given that Ostranauts shares a universe with NEO Scavenger.

I think the fundamental problem is that derelict exploration provides too much certainty too quickly. It should instead be a process of gradual information gathering, puzzle solving and probabilistic risk assessment. Ostranauts could benefit enormously from taking inspiration from Duskers.


[h1]HOW I THINK DERELICT EXPLORATION COULD WORK BETTER[/h1]

[b]1. PRE-DOCKING RECONNAISSANCE[/b]

Before docking, your ship should provide an incomplete sensor picture based on the capabilities of the equipment you have installed.

You might be able to assess broad structural integrity, thermal anomalies suggesting fire or operating machinery, electromagnetic emissions, radar returns, active distress signals, radiation, and gases leaking from the hull.

These observations should provide clues rather than answers. Elevated CO2 might suggest biological activity, decomposition or some functioning system. Flammable gas could make welding dangerous. Ammonia might indicate a damaged refrigeration or coolant system. Radiation could suggest a compromised reactor.

The purpose would not be to tell the player whether the derelict is "safe" or "dangerous", but to establish an uncertain initial risk assessment before deciding whether to dock.


[b]2. THE AIRLOCK AS THE FIRST MAJOR CHECKPOINT[/b]

Every closed boundary should represent an information-versus-risk decision.

Your own airlock should provide the best information because it belongs to your ship and can be progressively upgraded. An externally mounted camera, lighting and lidar could inspect the first accessible space. Other equipment could sample pressure, temperature, atmospheric composition and radiation before you expose yourself.

Sometimes those readings should be sufficiently concerning that the rational decision is simply not to open the airlock and to abandon the wreck.

Once you leave your own ship, however, that information advantage should rapidly deteriorate.


[b]3. INTERNAL DOORS SHOULD RESTORE UNCERTAINTY[/b]

Doors deeper inside the derelict should usually tell you very little about what is behind them.

You might detect structure-borne sound or vibration, unusual surface temperature, radiation penetrating the bulkhead, strong magnetic fields, or gases leaking through a damaged seal. But you should rarely know exactly what is in the next compartment before opening it.

Opening each significant door would therefore become a small decision under uncertainty rather than simply another mouse click.


[b]4. UNFOLDING ENVIRONMENTAL STORYTELLING SHOULD PROVIDE EVIDENCE[/b]

Every compartment should potentially contain evidence about what happened aboard the vessel and what risks might still remain.

Examples could include unknown biological material, human blood, fired cartridge cases, damaged equipment, improvised barricades, unusual structural damage or bodies whose condition provides further clues: were they shot, burnt, exposed to vacuum, poisoned, attacked by something, or killed in some other way?

Occasionally you might find a functioning terminal containing system logs, door controls, sensor feeds or fragmentary crew records.

None of these clues should provide certainty. They should update your estimate of the probability of different hazards being present.


[b]5. STAYING LONGER SHOULD INCREASE BOTH REWARD AND EXPOSURE RISK[/b]

A major part of derelict exploration should be deciding how long you are prepared to remain aboard.

The most valuable equipment might be deeper inside the ship or require considerable time and disturbance to remove. The player should therefore continually balance:

possible salvage reward against the probability and consequences of something going wrong.
Importantly, threats should not simply be waiting statically for the player to discover them.

A structurally compromised vessel might suffer a pressure-boundary or structural failure that closes your return route. A damaged reactor, electrical system or gas line might deteriorate while you are aboard. Salvaging might disturb autonomous systems that were previously dormant.

An alien infestation could initially remain hidden, with the probability of emergence changing over time and increasing as the player restores power, raises temperature, opens compartments or performs increasingly invasive salvage operations.

Autonomous weapons or a hostile ship AI might come online. Interaction with a shipborne AI could itself make use of Ostranauts' existing social mechanics: perhaps you can negotiate with it, persuade it to provide information, convince it that you are authorised to be there, or accidentally make it hostile.

External conditions could also change while you remain aboard: another salvage crew or pirates could dock at another airlock, someone could wait to intercept you when you leave, or the wreck could suffer an impact from debris or micrometeoroids.

The important point is that the player should never be completely certain that the state of the derelict when they boarded will remain its state twenty minutes later. Also I think such uncertainty based mechanics would benefit from some very large derelicts that take substantial time to traverse or escape from.


[b]6. SHIPBREAKING ITSELF SHOULD BE HAZARDOUS[/b]

Environmental hazards should remain an active puzzle and risk throughout salvaging.

Using the wrong tool in the wrong environment should have consequences. Cutting or welding around flammable explosive gases, dismantling live electrical equipment, removing structurally important components, disturbing pressurised systems/spaces or working around hazardous chemicals should require knowledge and preparation.

Fatigue, panic, stress and injury should also matter. A tired or panicked character performing dangerous industrial work in an unfamiliar damaged spacecraft should be considerably more likely to make mistakes.

As it stands, shipbreaking is mostly a matter of waiting for components to be dismantled, repaired, removed and moved about. Ostranauts already simulates many of the physical systems necessary to make this far more interesting. What is missing for me is the way those systems interact to produce uncertainty, emergent danger and difficult decisions.

The game does not simply need more enemies. It needs derelicts that remain unknown for longer, reveal themselves gradually, change while you are aboard them, and force you to continually adapt and decide whether the next component, room or piece of information is worth the additional risk.
items.text_zh:
[b]我真的很想喜欢这款游戏，但对我来说，它未能提供一种引人入胜的废弃飞船探索体验。[/b]

探索废弃飞船的核心循环变得重复、基本没有风险，而且缺乏紧张感。登上废弃飞船后没几分钟，你通常就能非常清楚它有多危险。风险似乎非常有限，而关于会遇到什么的信息几乎是立刻就能获得，而不是通过一个充满不确定性、调查以及风险与回报权衡决策的漫长过程。如果你有热成像面罩，你甚至能绝对确定地探测到船上某个人的体温，而无需身处同一个房间，即使隔着墙壁和关闭的门（透视视觉）。

尽管游戏模拟了压力、大气、温度、火灾和设备状况，但在我日常探索废弃飞船的过程中，几乎没遇到过真正需要诊断、准备或应对的涌现性环境危害。拆船本身通常平淡无奇：选择适当的交互，然后等待某物被拆解、修理或移除。

日常探索中缺乏实质性的程序化太空恐怖元素也令人失望。这里有着巨大的潜力，可以借鉴《异形》、《深空失忆》或《黑洞表面》的元素，而它的缺失显得尤其奇怪，因为《奥斯特拉号》与《新拾荒者》共享同一个宇宙。

我认为根本问题在于，废弃飞船探索过快提供了太多确定性。它本应是一个逐步收集信息、解谜和进行概率风险评估的过程。《奥斯特拉号》可以从《黄昏拾荒者》中汲取灵感，从而获益良多。


[h1]我认为废弃飞船探索如何能做得更好[/h1]

[b]1. 对接前侦察[/b]

在对接之前，你的飞船应根据你所安装设备的能力，提供一幅不完整的传感器图像。

你或许能够评估大致的结构完整性、暗示火灾或运转机械的热异常、电磁辐射、雷达回波、主动求救信号、辐射，以及从船体泄漏的气体。

这些观察结果应提供线索而非答案。二氧化碳浓度升高可能暗示生物活动、腐烂或某个仍在运转的系统。可燃气体可能使焊接变得危险。氨气可能表明制冷或冷却系统受损。辐射可能暗示反应堆受损。

其目的不是告诉玩家废弃飞船是“安全”还是“危险”，而是在决定是否对接之前，建立一个不确定的初步风险评估。


[b]2. 气闸作为第一个主要检查点[/b]

每一道封闭的边界都应代表一个信息与风险之间的决策。

你自己的气闸应提供最好的信息，因为它属于你的飞船，并且可以逐步升级。一个外部安装的摄像头、照明和激光雷达可以检查第一个可进入的空间。其他设备可以在你暴露自己之前采样压力、温度、大气成分和辐射。

有时这些读数应该足够令人担忧，以至于理性的决定就是干脆不打开气闸，放弃这艘残骸。

然而，一旦你离开自己的飞船，这种信息优势应迅速恶化。


[b]3. 内部舱门应恢复不确定性[/b]

废弃飞船更深处的舱门通常应几乎不告诉你门后有什么。

你可能会探测到结构传播的声音或振动、异常的舱壁表面温度、穿透舱壁的辐射、强磁场，或通过受损密封处泄漏的气体。但你应该很少能在打开下一个隔舱之前确切知道里面有什么。

因此，打开每一道重要的门都应成为一个在不确定性下做出的小决策，而不仅仅是又一次鼠标点击。


[b]4. 逐步展开的环境叙事应提供证据[/b]

每个隔舱都可能包含关于船上发生了什么以及可能仍存在哪些风险的证据。

例子可能包括未知生物材料、人类血液、发射过的弹壳、损坏的设备、临时路障、异常的结构损伤，或尸体——其状况能提供进一步线索：他们是被枪杀、烧死、暴露于真空、中毒、被某种东西袭击，还是以其他方式被杀？

偶尔你可能会发现一个仍在运转的终端，里面包含系统日志、舱门控制、传感器数据或零碎的船员记录。

这些线索都不应提供确定性。它们应更新你对不同危害存在概率的估计。


[b]5. 停留更久应同时增加回报和暴露风险[/b]

废弃飞船探索的一个重要部分应是决定你准备在船上停留多久。

最有价值的设备可能位于飞船更深处，或者需要相当长的时间和扰动才能移除。因此，玩家应不断权衡：

可能的打捞回报与出问题的概率及后果。
重要的是，威胁不应只是静态地等待玩家去发现。

一艘结构受损的飞船可能发生压力边界或结构失效，从而切断你的返回路线。受损的反应堆、电气系统或气体管线可能在你登船期间恶化。打捞可能扰动先前处于休眠状态的自主系统。

外星生物侵染可能最初保持隐藏，其出现的概率随时间变化，并随着玩家恢复电力、升高温度、打开隔舱或执行越来越具侵入性的打捞作业而增加。

自主武器或充满敌意的飞船AI可能上线。与舰载AI的互动本身就可以利用《奥斯特拉号》现有的社交机制：也许你可以与它谈判、说服它提供信息、让它相信你有权在那里，或者不小心让它变得敌对。

当你留在船上时，外部条件也可能发生变化：另一支打捞队或海盗可能停靠到另一个气闸，有人可能在你离开时等着拦截你，或者残骸可能遭到碎片或微流星体的撞击。

关键点在于，玩家永远不应完全确定废弃飞船在他们登船时的状态会在二十分钟后保持不变。此外，我认为这种基于不确定性的机制会受益于一些非常巨大的废弃飞船，需要花费大量时间才能穿越或逃离。


[b]6. 拆船本身应具有危险性[/b]

环境危害应在整个打捞过程中始终是一个活跃的谜题和风险。

在错误的环境中使用错误的工具应产生后果。在易燃易爆气体周围切割或焊接、拆卸带电电气设备、移除结构上重要的部件、扰动加压系统/空间，或在危险化学品周围作业，都应需要知识和准备。

疲劳、恐慌、压力和受伤也应产生影响。一个疲惫或恐慌的角色在一艘陌生且受损的航天器中进行危险的工业作业时，应更有可能犯错。

就目前而言，拆船主要是等待部件被拆解、修理、移除和搬来搬去。《奥斯特拉号》已经模拟了许多必要的物理系统，本可以让这一切变得有趣得多。对我来说，缺失的是这些系统相互作用以产生不确定性、涌现性危险和艰难决策的方式。

这款游戏不仅仅需要更多敌人。它需要那些能在更长时间内保持未知、逐渐显露自身、在你登船期间发生变化，并迫使你不断适应并决定下一个部件、房间或信息是否值得承担额外风险的废弃飞船。
对它们背后隐藏着什么几乎一无所知。

你可能会探测到结构传声或振动、异常的舱壁表面温度、穿透舱壁的辐射、强磁场，或从受损密封处泄漏的气体。但你在打开下一个隔舱之前，很少能确切知道里面有什么。

因此，打开每一扇重要的门都会成为一次不确定条件下的微小决策，而不仅仅是又一次鼠标点击。


[b]4. 逐步展开的环境叙事应当提供证据[/b]

每个隔舱都可能包含关于船上发生了什么、以及可能仍存在哪些风险的证据。

例子可能包括未知的生物材料、人类血液、发射过的弹壳、损坏的设备、临时搭建的路障、异常的结构损伤，或尸体——其状况能提供进一步线索：他们是被枪杀、烧死、暴露于真空、毒死、被某种东西袭击，还是以其他方式被杀？

偶尔你可能会发现一台仍在运行的终端，里面存有系统日志、门控装置、传感器数据流或残缺的船员记录。

这些线索都不应提供确定性。它们应当更新你对不同危险存在概率的估计。


[b]5. 停留更久应当同时增加回报与暴露风险[/b]

废弃飞船探索的一个重要部分，应当是决定你准备在船上停留多久。

最有价值的设备可能位于飞船更深处，或者需要相当长的时间和扰动才能拆除。因此，玩家应当持续权衡：

可能的打捞回报，与某件事出错的概率及其后果。
重要的是，威胁不应只是静止地等待玩家去发现它们。

外星生物侵染最初可能保持隐藏，其显现概率会随时间变化，并随着玩家恢复电力、升高温度、打开隔舱或执行越来越具侵入性的打捞作业而增加。

外部条件也可能在你留在船上期间发生变化：另一支打捞队或海盗可能停靠到另一个气闸，有人可能在你离开时等着拦截你，或者残骸可能遭到碎片或微流星体的撞击。

关键的一点是，玩家永远不应完全确定：他们登船时残骸的状态，二十分钟后仍会保持不变。此外，我认为这种基于不确定性的机制，会受益于一些非常巨大的残骸——需要花费大量时间才能穿越或逃离。


[b]6. 拆船本身应当具有危险性[/b]

环境危害应当在整个打捞过程中始终是一个活跃的谜题与风险。

在错误的环境中使用错误的工具应当产生后果。在易燃易爆气体周围进行切割或焊接、拆卸带电的电气设备、移除结构上重要的部件、扰动
加压系统/空间或在危险化学品周围作业，应当需要知识和准备。

疲劳、恐慌、压力和受伤也应当有影响。一个疲惫或恐慌的角色，在一艘不熟悉的受损航天器上从事危险的工业作业时，犯错的概率应当显著更高。

就目前而言，拆船基本上就是等待部件被拆解、修复、移除和搬来搬去。Ostranauts 已经模拟了许多必要的物理系统，本可以让这一切变得有趣得多。对我来说，缺失的是这些系统相互作用以产生不确定性、涌现性危险和艰难决策的方式。

这款游戏并不只是需要更多敌人。它需要的是那些在更长时间内保持未知、逐渐显露自身、在你登船期间发生变化，并迫使你不断适应、判断下一个部件、房间或信息是否值得承担额外风险的废弃飞船。

observations.evidence_zh: 探索废弃飞船的核心循环变得重复、基本没有风险，并且缺乏紧张感。

observations.description: 常规探索中几乎不会遇到需要诊断、准备或适应的突发环境危害
observations.evidence: I have encountered almost no emergent environmental hazards during routine derelict exploration that actually require diagnosis, preparation or adaptation.
observations.evidence_zh: 在常规的废弃飞船探索中，我几乎没有遇到过真正需要诊断、准备或适应的涌现性环境危害。

observations.description: 拆船过程平淡无奇，只需选择互动并等待
observations.evidence: Shipbreaking itself is generally uneventful: choose the appropriate interaction and wait for something to be dismantled, repaired or removed.
observations.evidence_zh: 拆船本身通常平淡无奇：选择适当的交互方式，然后等待某物被拆解、修理或移除。

items.text:
This is that rare case where a Neutral recommendation would fit perfectly. I marked it as No, but that is not a negative verdict. I like the game a lot — I just want other buyers to know what they are stepping into. I have 250+ hours in it, and I have barely flown outside the starting OKLG area. I had so much fun there that I stayed… and that is exactly where the current shortcomings became obvious.

The good (short list — it is a decent game, so these are the standouts):

- A great, hardcore space sim with a lot of freedom
- Excellent start: character creation and the mortgage make the opening hours properly challenging
- Solid shipbuilding, including bits you can scavenge from derelicts
- A scavenger economy that actually hurts. You feel it when a part is missing, the nearby station does not have it, and you have to cut and sell a liver to afford it
- You pay for everything — including the ability to take a breath
- Flying through a customizable navigation panel. Painful at first, and it takes getting used to, but it is a genuinely good idea

What you have to be ready for - negatives -  (the longer list — this is why I stopped where I did, hoping for a better experience later):

- It may be labelled 1.0, but it does not feel like it, especially on optimisation. After the last patch, the OKLG docking area has about 3× as many NPCs, and the game slows down badly. Running at 4× while retrofitting ships is basically undoable. UI is not decoupled from simulation either: when it stutters, you cannot even pause. That suggests little or no multithreading.
- Task ordering. You can queue work for yourself or a small crew (I never got far with crew; I used my main character and a task list, which is far more efficient than doing jobs one by one). With a large queue — for example stripping a whole derelict — tasks run line by line, top-down or bottom-up, instead of nearest-next. I assume the task creator just scans in vertical rows. The result is a lot of wasted walking when the character starts a new “line.”
- No mass task cancel. If you realise mid-way you made a mistake, you delete jobs one by one. That can mean a few hundred clicks. We already have an Orders “painter.” A cancel painter would be an obvious next step.
I completely accept hand-managing the ship at the start: scrap hull, scavenge, patch, refill O2 bottles for EVA suits, manually fill N2/O2 canisters outside a station. Later, though, I expected access to more expensive, higher-tier gear that automates some of this — EVA bottle refill stations, piping so scavenged N2 canisters can feed a refill network, popping installed canisters from barrels, and especially automatic pressure detection.
- Automatic hauling is atrocious, including installing parts on the ship. Characters often keep dragging an item even after that item’s job is already supplied — sometimes by the same character. They deliver a few pieces, start dragging a wall, then freeze because there is “no space” to carry the next thing.
- Wall building assumes a perfectly clean space. The character will not clear debris first. You babysit and micromanage, or the job fails.
- Hauling to designated areas is a mess. Items often end up outside the zone, or even outside the ship, behind the walls. Typical haul-order behaviour: (1) they carry items one by one, or only a few similar ones, well below capacity; (2) they drag an item to the drop point, then happily drag it back while going for the next one; (3) they take things from your haul area and dump them back on the derelict they were supposed to empty. This was the last straw. If I had an NPC crew making that kind of mess, I would rage-space them without EVA suits.
- Character dialogue is bad. I know the game is task-based, but conversations do not fit that model (wait, reply, wait, reply). Combat is the same: task commands you have to repeat on the target. The command order also changes, so I mixed up “slap” and “stab” more than once.
- Micro-asteroids are frustrating — not because they exist. For a project this realistic, they belong. The problem is I found myself repairing the exact same spot up to eight times in a row while stripping a derelict. Hits have no graduated damage: they always shred wall + floor + circuits to the breaking point, never halfway.
- Floor and wall strength barely matter. Weight is the only value that counts. Heavier “luxury” parts and more militaristic ones are just role-play.
- The building app desperately needs parts grouped by family instead of one long list.
- A ship cargo manifest is a must. I cannot remember whether I have 110 or 210 floor pieces when collecting for a retrofit.
- Fusion-reactor logistics (the large canisters) really need pipelines — a proper pumping system, and a way to refill HE3 from scavenged canisters. Water is the same: no plumbing; you still haul bottles to sinks.
- Relatively little part variation. There is a lot of equipment, but each piece has one job. You rarely get competing tiers (air pump vs turbo air pump, normal intake vs Hydra intake). Stats are also thin: power draw while working vs idle, and so on.
- Characters swapping batteries in devices or EVA suits tend to dump stuff on the floor. I have also seen them forget to swap EVA batteries or O2 bottles while working, then stand there gasping.
- Your PDA could use some app to remote control stuff. We already have signal boxes, would be great to have ability to trigger them from PDA. Also when on derelict you have no remote access to you own Nav station, so even if you get some signal about some event, you can't check anything until you back into you ship "map"
- Considering how fast you can get rick with meat and scavenged cargo holds... we need more equipment in various price ranges or more difficult / time-consuming repairs (which would require more durability in exchange). My last save was about 5.6MLN, without flying of OKLG - starting area. I just happen to land on very HEAVILY infested ship so I played the butcher.
- And more I have forgotten for now.

This is a great idea wrapped in a lot of small frustrations. Nothing is fundamentally broken, and playing is fun — until you get tired of fighting the systems. A lot of this could be mods; the Workshop already has several attempts. I get the feeling the codebase is still in flux, though, so a mod that works today may not survive the next patch.

If you can live with the above, you will have a great time. I did — especially in the first 100 hours. After that I started hitting walls: the automation I'd  expect as I progress is not there, and it looks like I will have to micromanage everything forever. Definitely not wasted time. Just a bit disappointed.
items.text_zh:
这是那种罕见的情况，一个“中立”推荐会完美契合。我把它标记为“不推荐”，但那并不是负面评价。我非常喜欢这款游戏——我只是想让其他买家知道他们要面对什么。我在里面已经玩了250多个小时，而我几乎没有飞出过起始的OKLG区域。我在那里玩得太开心了，所以就留了下来……而正是在那里，当前的缺点变得显而易见。

优点（简短列表——这是一款不错的游戏，所以这些是突出之处）：

- 一款出色、硬核且自由度很高的太空模拟游戏
- 极佳的开局：角色创建和房贷让最初几个小时的挑战性恰到好处
- 扎实的造船系统，包括可以从废弃飞船中打捞到的零件
- 一种真的会让你感到肉痛的拾荒经济。当缺少一个零件、附近空间站又没有、而你不得不割下一个肝卖掉才买得起时，你能真切感受到这一点
- 一切都要花钱——包括呼吸的能力
- 通过可自定义的导航面板飞行。起初很痛苦，也需要时间适应，但这确实是个好主意

你必须准备好面对的事——缺点——（更长的列表——这就是我为什么停在了当时那个进度，希望以后能有更好的体验）：

- 它可能被标为1.0，但感觉并不像，尤其是在优化方面。上次补丁之后，OKLG停靠区大约多了3倍的NPC，游戏严重变慢。改装飞船时以4倍速运行基本没法玩。UI也没有与模拟解耦：卡顿时，你甚至无法暂停。这说明多线程很少或根本没有。
- 任务排序。你可以为自己或一个小船员队列安排工作（我从未在船员方面走得很远；我用主角和一个任务列表，这比一件件做工作高效得多）。当队列很大时——例如拆解一整艘废弃飞船——任务会按行、自上而下或自下而上运行，而不是按最近的下一个执行。我猜任务创建器只是按垂直行扫描。结果是，当角色开始新的一“行”时，会浪费大量走路时间。
- 没有批量取消任务。如果你中途意识到自己犯了错，就只能一个个删除工作。那可能意味着几百次点击。我们已经有了订单“画笔”。取消画笔显然是下一步。
我完全接受开局时手动管理飞船：刮船体、拾荒、修补、为EVA服补充O2瓶、在空间站外手动填充N2/O2罐。但后来，我期待能获得更昂贵、更高档的装备来自动化其中一些事情——EVA瓶补充站、让打捞来的N2罐接入补充网络的管道、从桶中取出已安装的罐，尤其是自动压力检测。
- 自动搬运糟糕透顶，包括在飞船上安装零件。角色常常在该物品的工作已经被供给之后还继续拖着它——有时还是同一个角色。他们送了几件东西，开始拖一堵墙，然后因为“没有空间”携带下一件东西而卡住。
- 建造墙壁假定空间完全干净。角色不会先清理碎片。你要么像保姆一样微观管理，要么工作失败。
- 搬运到指定区域一团糟。物品常常最终落在区域外，甚至飞船外、墙后面。典型的搬运命令行为：（1）他们一件件搬，或者只搬几件相似的，远低于容量；（2）他们把物品拖到投放点，然后在去拿下一件时又高高兴兴地把它拖回去；（3）他们从你的搬运区拿东西，然后丢回本该清空的废弃飞船上。这是最后一根稻草。如果我有一个NPC船员制造这种烂摊子，我会气得把他们不穿EVA服就扔进太空。
- 角色对话很糟糕。我知道游戏是基于任务的，但对话并不符合那种模式（等待、回复、等待、回复）。战斗也一样：你必须对目标重复下达任务命令。命令顺序还会变化，所以我不止一次把“扇耳光”和“刺”搞混。
- 微型小行星很烦人——不是因为它们存在。对于这样一个追求真实感的项目来说，它们本就该有。问题是在拆解一艘废弃飞船时，我发现自己连续修复同一个位置多达八次。撞击没有渐进式损伤：它们总是把墙+地板+电路撕到崩溃边缘，从来不会只损坏一半。
- 地板和墙壁的强度几乎无关紧要。重量才是唯一重要的数值。更重的“豪华”部件和更军事化的部件只是角色扮演。
- 建造应用迫切需要按类别分组零件，而不是一个长长的列表。
- 飞船货物清单是必须的。在为改装收集材料时，我记不住自己是有110块还是210块地板件。
- 聚变反应堆物流（大型罐）真的需要管道——一个正经的泵送系统，以及从打捞来的罐中补充HE3的方法。水也一样：没有管道；你仍然要把瓶子搬到水槽。
- 零件变化相对很少。设备很多，但每件只有一个用途。你很少看到相互竞争的档次（空气泵 vs 涡轮空气泵，普通进气口 vs 海德拉进气口）。属性也很单薄：工作时与空闲时的耗电等等。
- 角色在设备或EVA服中更换电池时，往往会把东西丢在地上。我还见过他们在工作时忘记更换EVA电池或O2瓶，然后站在那里喘气。
- 你的PDA可以加一些远程控制东西的应用。我们已经有信号盒了，如果能从PDA触发它们会很棒。另外，在废弃飞船上时，你无法远程访问自己的导航站，所以即使你收到某个事件的信号，也要回到飞船“地图”才能查看任何东西。
- 考虑到用肉和打捞来的货舱能多快变富……我们需要更多不同价位的设备，或者更困难/更耗时的修理（作为交换，这需要更高的耐久度）。我上一个存档大约有560万，还没飞出OKLG——起始区域。我只是碰巧降落在一艘感染极其严重的飞船上，于是当起了屠夫。
- 还有更多我现在已经忘了的。

这是一个伟大的点子，包裹在许多小小的挫败感之中。没有什么根本性的损坏，玩起来也很有趣——直到你厌倦了与各种系统作斗争。其中很多本可以做成mod；创意工坊已经有几次尝试了。不过我感觉代码库仍在变动，所以今天能用的mod可能撑不过下一个补丁。

如果你能忍受上述问题，你会玩得很开心。我就是这样——尤其是在最初的100个小时里。之后我开始撞墙：我期望随着进度获得的自动化并不存在，而且看起来我将不得不永远微观管理一切。绝对不是浪费时间。只是有点失望。
你的搬运区域，然后把它们扔回本该被清空的废弃飞船上。这是压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草。如果我有一队NPC船员搞出这种烂摊子，我会不给他们穿EVA服就把他们扔进太空。
- 角色对话很糟糕。我知道这游戏是基于任务的，但对话并不适合那种模式（等待、回复、等待、回复）。战斗也一样：你必须在目标身上重复下达任务指令。指令顺序还会变，所以我不止一次把“扇耳光”和“捅刺”搞混了。
- 微型小行星很烦人——不是因为它们存在。对于一个如此写实的项目来说，它们本就该有。问题在于，我在拆解一艘废弃飞船时，发现自己最多连续八次修理同一个位置。撞击没有渐进式损伤：它们总是把墙壁+地板+电路直接撕到报废边缘，从来不会只损坏一半。
- 地板和墙壁的强度几乎无关紧要。重量才是唯一重要的数值。更重的“豪华”部件和更军事化的部件都只是角色扮演。
- 建造应用迫切需要按部件族系分组，而不是一个长长的列表。
- 飞船货物清单是必须的。在为改装收集材料时，我记不清自己是有110块还是210块地板。
- 聚变反应堆物流（那些大罐子）真的需要管道——一套正经的泵送系统，以及从捡来的罐子里补充HE3的方法。水也一样：没有管道；你还是得把瓶子搬到水槽边。
- 部件种类相对较少。设备很多，但每件只有一个用途。你很少能看到相互竞争的层级（空气泵 vs 涡轮空气泵，普通进气口 vs 海德拉进气口）。属性也很单薄：工作时与待机时的功耗，等等。
- 角色在设备或EVA服里换电池时，往往会把东西丢在地上。我还见过他们在工作时忘记更换EVA电池或O2瓶，然后站在那里喘气。
- 你的PDA可以加个应用来远程控制东西。我们已经有信号盒了，能从PDA触发它们会很好。另外，在废弃飞船上时，你无法远程访问自己的导航站，所以即使你收到某个事件的信号，也得回到飞船的“地图”里才能查看任何东西。
- 考虑到靠卖肉和捡来的货舱能多快变富……我们需要更多不同价位的设备，或者更困难/更耗时的修理（这反过来又需要更高的耐久度）。我上一个存档大约有560万，还没飞出OKLG——起始区域。我只是碰巧降落在一艘被严重感染的飞船上，所以我就当起了屠夫。
- 还有更多我暂时忘了的。

这是一个很棒的点子，包裹在大量小挫折里。没有什么根本性的损坏，玩起来也很有趣——直到你厌倦了和这些系统较劲。其中很多可以做成模组；创意工坊里已经有几次尝试了。不过我感觉代码库仍在变动中，所以今天能用的模组可能撑不过下一个补丁。

如果你能忍受以上这些，你会玩得很开心。我就是这样——尤其是在最初的100小时里。之后我开始撞墙：我期望随着进度推进而出现的自动化并不存在，看起来我将不得不永远事无巨细地管理一切。绝对不算浪费时间。只是有点失望。

items.text:
Put a lot of hours into the game but it's still a buggy when it's stable and broken when it isn't. 

So many deaths don't feel like I have any control over. Being obliterated by a hauler going mach ♥♥♥♥ while I'm docked on a wreck, an unpressurised "engine room" blowing up due to over pressurisation and the worst I've experienced recently my character refusing to breathe outside of an EVA suit including the starting space station. 

Ship building is also a slog, making a retrofit of expansion such a headache. You can't rely of autotask because it will leave holes or for some reason bounce from one corner of the work area to the other furthest corner and leave holes and gaps everywhere but then doing it manually will take ages
items.text_zh:
在这游戏里投入了很多小时，但它在稳定时依然有bug，不稳定时就直接崩坏。

那么多死亡让我感觉完全无法控制。当我停靠在一艘残骸上时，被一艘以♥♥♥♥速度飞行的运输船轰成渣，一个未加压的“引擎室”因过度加压而爆炸，还有我最近经历的最糟情况——我的角色拒绝在EVA服外呼吸，包括在起始空间站里。

造船也是件苦差事，做一次扩建改装就头疼得要命。你不能依赖自动任务，因为它会留下漏洞，或者不知为何从工作区的一个角落弹到最远的另一个角落，到处留下漏洞和缝隙，但手动做又要花上很久。

observations.description: 自动任务会留下孔洞或在工作区对角间跳跃，留下缝隙

items.text:
Es ist eines der wenigen Spiele, in die man richtig viel Zeit stecken kann.
Als Scavenger baust du dir dein Schiff auf, plünderst/zerlegst alte Wracks und baust dir nach und nach dein Schiff auf. Alles ist darauf ausgelegt, dass Fortschritt immer mit viel Zeit verbunden ist.
Es hat mich über 72 h gebraucht ehe ich es geschafft hab ein Reaktor im Schiff zu installieren. Hat man ihn erreicht man all die anderen fernen Orte. 
Währenddessen begegnet man Piraten, Kometeneinschläge, Patrouillen. Es gibt im Hintergrund noch side-stories. (z.b. kann man den Tod einer Leiche aufklären versuchen, oder das Geheimnis hinter dem mystery Meat lüften) 
Ein bisschen überflüssig finde ich in einem solchen spiel social-moods. Torchdrive-Reisen sind auch nichts anderes als skip 6h x-Mal bis man am Ziel ist. 
Aber das Spiel bietet so auch eine Reihe an Möglichkeiten, so kann man selbst andere Schiffe überfallen und ausrauben, Schiffswracks kaufen, instand setzen und verkaufen, Trading - Routen fliegen und noch kleinere Quests, sowie als auch Bounty-Hunter-Missionen. 
Das Spiel hat folglich seinen Charm, und der Loot ist Random... kommst du auf ein Wrack, kann es absolut bis auf paar Wände zerstört sein oder man findet 3 Volle He3 Tanks... 

Wie baut man sein Schiff am besten auf? Abbauen von Wracks, Reparieren, anbauen. Gewicht und Thrust ist aufeinander abgestimmt, je mehr Tonnen du hast, desto mehr Thruster brauchst du, desto mehr Treibstoff brauchst du... etc. 

Nach über 108h nun kann ich das Spiel nur empfehlen. 
Bislang bin ich noch über keine der angeblich so vielen Bugs gestoßen.
items.text_zh:
这是少数几款能让你真正投入大量时间的游戏之一。
作为拾荒者，你建造自己的飞船，掠夺/拆解旧残骸，逐步搭建起你的飞船。一切都设计成进步总是与大量时间挂钩。
我花了超过72小时才成功在飞船上安装一个反应堆。有了它，你就能到达所有其他遥远的地方。
在此期间，你会遇到海盗、彗星撞击、巡逻队。背景中还有支线故事。（比如你可以尝试查明一具尸体的死因，或者揭开神秘肉背后的秘密）
我觉得在这类游戏里社交情绪有点多余。火炬驱动旅行也不过是跳过6小时重复多次直到抵达目的地。
但这款游戏也提供了很多可能性，比如你可以自己袭击并抢劫其他飞船、购买飞船残骸、修复并出售、跑贸易路线，还有更小的任务，以及赏金猎人任务。
因此这款游戏有它的魅力，而且战利品是随机的……你来到一处残骸，它可能除了几面墙之外完全被摧毁，也可能找到3个装满He3的罐子……

如何最好地建造你的飞船？拆解残骸、修理、扩建。重量和推力是相互匹配的，你吨位越大，需要的推进器就越多，需要的燃料也就越多……等等。

现在玩了超过108小时后，我只能推荐这款游戏。
到目前为止，我还没遇到据说那么多的bug中的任何一个。

items.text:
Игра в целом классная, особенно для тех, кто любит что то создавать или собирать из хлама и смотреть, как груда мусора превращается в самодостаточную крепость со всем. Но она будто пустая? Просто по примерам:

Плюсы:

1)Атмосферность 
2)Идея выпустить Плюшкина на максимум
3)Собирать из огрызка мега бубылду или реставрировать
4)Система прогрессии (Навыки, инструменты, разные комнаты и тд)
5)Чувство приключения, летать по большой системе (Но пустоватой)

Минусы:

1)Интерфейс, конечно, та еще прикормка. Даже спустя столько времени иногда жжет
2)Нпс вроде есть, но зачем они? Непонятно. Опять же сравнение: В мире риса пешка будет делать что то по команде и сама тащить на склад, производить и тд. Здесь же - если вы наймете нпс - да, плюс пара рук, но в чем беда то? Если не укажете каждый параметр чертового склада и не поставите автозадачу навсегда  - нпс просто будет существовать
3)Бесполезные взаимодействия. Ощущение что просто ради надо. Вроде болтаете и все такое, но часто вы несете чушь (Просто нет выбора сделать что то другое), так и к тому же это бесполезно. Текст ради текста
4)Мало компонентов. Опять же мир риса: Начал с лука - закончил энерговинтовкой, но до неё более десятка разного выбора. А тут: Двигатель от жиги или премиальная PUMP♂♂♂. Типа просто черное и белое и так почти со всем
5)Нечасто, но....: [spoiler] Вы можете иметь десять лет опыта пилотирования, но на вас со скоростью в 1 км/с поприветствует сборщик дереликта. Особенно у станций [/spoiler]
6) 5 пункт и с полицаями связан: [spoiler] У вас все легально? Дай посмотрю. Эти шизоиды на скорости разгоняются в вас как в гта и потом вы, полицай летите куда то. Ждете, пока он ответит и высок риск забубениться в дереликт. Отстыковаться нет возможности чтобы это исправить во время процесса. Спасибо папаша за парковку на планету со скоростью 174м/с. Решает вопрос: ускоренный допрос свинцом [/spoiler]
7)Рутина. Да, хоть я и похвалил за сборку, но тут буквально разбор ради разбора, чтобы получить деньги, но ради чего? Виза там? Шрамы убрать после прошлой перепалки? Ну наверное да, но спорное блюдо

Итог: Игра сырая, но если закрывать глаза на многое то, что надо исправлять, доделывать или удалять - сойдет
items.text_zh:
游戏整体来说很酷，尤其是对于那些喜欢创造或从破烂中拼凑东西，并看着一堆垃圾变成自给自足的堡垒的人来说。但它好像很空洞？举个例子：

优点：

1）氛围感
2）把普柳什金发挥到极致的主意
3）用残骸拼出超级大宝贝或进行修复
4）成长系统（技能、工具、各种房间等等）
5）冒险感，在一个大星系里飞行（但有点空）

缺点：

1）界面，那真是够呛。即使过了这么久，有时还是让人火大
2）NPC好像有，但他们有什么用？不清楚。再对比一下：在《大米世界》里，棋子会按命令做事，自己把东西拖到仓库、生产等等。而这里——如果你雇了NPC——是的，多了几只手，但问题在哪？如果你不指定该死的仓库的每一个参数，不永久设置自动任务——NPC就只是存在而已
3）无用的互动。感觉只是为了有而有。好像在聊天之类的，但经常你在说废话（只是没有选择做别的事），而且这还没用。为了文本而文本
4）组件太少。还是《大米世界》：从弓开始——最后到能量螺旋枪，但中间有十多种不同选择。而这里：日古利发动机或高级PUMP♂♂♂。就像只有黑与白，几乎一切都这样
5）不常发生，但……：[spoiler] 你可能拥有十年飞行经验，但一个残骸收集者会以1公里/秒的速度来跟你打招呼。尤其是在空间站附近 [/spoiler]
6）第5点也和警察有关：[spoiler] 你一切合法？让我看看。这些疯子像在GTA里一样加速朝你冲过来，然后你，警察，飞向某处。等着他回应，而且撞上残骸的风险很高。过程中没法脱离来修正。谢谢老爹以174米/秒的速度停到星球上。解决问题的方法：用铅弹加速审讯 [/spoiler]
7）例行公事。是的，虽然我夸了拼装，但这里字面意义上是为了拆解而拆解，为了赚钱，但为了什么？签证？把上次争吵后的伤疤去掉？嗯，大概是的，但这是道有争议的菜

总结：游戏很生涩，但如果对很多需要修复、完善或删除的东西睁一只眼闭一只眼——还凑合

items.text:
For every good thing this game has going for it, it hinges comepletely on the player to not break the fragile mess this game is. 
The whole Oooh you are poor and have a lot of debt! Thing is going out the window after MAYBE 3rd salvage run if you are very unlucky.
Everything takes AGES to do, it's one of those games you can just leave running and go do something else while your guy/guys are fixing stuff up or whatever else as it takes so long. 
Almost and i mean like 60% of game's content is not explained and a lot of key features are straight up left unexplained, leaving you wasting hours getting a hang of core mechanics such as Long distance travel.
 
Orbital navigation is straight up obysmal. I grew up on KSP and THAT game is 3d, and this game does everything to make orbital navigation and maneuvers feel unresponsive, finicky and lacking in information. 
Aside from salvaging, which is something you always have to start with, there is mining, how do i know that? Because some documentation explains how to do that? Nope, it's because some dude is selling mining gear and how do i know how to mine? I guess better go to the discord! 

But that's not the main problem. Even in the KitFox advert they show that the entire game world is broken. You can just dock to people's ships, uninstall their fuel tanks and haul them back on your ship and nobody bats an eye. You can just break every station by just uninstalling the walls or just opening every airlock, killing everyone. I have to restrain myself because nobody will stop you from breaking the game, leaving you with just making money on repeat. 

And after all that this game comes out of early access? I regret buying this years ago thinking they will make something better.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏虽然有种种优点，但一切都完全取决于玩家不去破坏这个脆弱不堪的烂摊子。
所谓“哦你好穷啊还欠了一屁股债！”的设定，在你大概第三次打捞任务之后（如果你特别倒霉的话）就彻底形同虚设了。
做什么事都要花上老半天，这就是那种你可以直接让它挂着运行、自己去干别的事的游戏，因为你的角色/角色们修理东西或干其他什么事都要花太长时间。
游戏内容里几乎——我是说大约60%——都没有解释，很多关键功能干脆就完全没说明，让你白白浪费好几个小时才摸清核心机制，比如远距离航行。

轨道导航简直糟糕透顶。我是玩KSP长大的，那游戏可是3D的，而这款游戏想尽办法让轨道导航和机动操作感觉迟钝、别扭、信息匮乏。
除了打捞——这是你永远都得先做的事——还有采矿，我怎么知道有采矿的？因为有哪份文档解释了怎么采矿吗？没有，是因为有个家伙在卖采矿装备，那我又怎么知道怎么采矿？我猜最好还是去Discord问问吧！

但这还不是主要问题。就连KitFox的广告里都展示了整个游戏世界是崩坏的。你可以直接对接别人的飞船，拆下他们的燃料箱拖回自己船上，没人会眨一下眼。你可以直接拆掉墙壁或打开所有气闸来破坏每一个空间站，杀死所有人。我得克制自己，因为没人会阻止你破坏游戏，结果你就只能一遍遍重复赚钱。

经历了这一切之后，这游戏居然还脱离了抢先体验？我真后悔几年前买下它，还以为他们会做出更好的东西。

observations.description: 游戏中的一切都需要很长时间，可以放着不管去做其他事。
observations.evidence: Everything takes AGES to do, it's one of those games you can just leave running and go do something else
observations.evidence_zh: 做任何事情都要花上好久好久，这是那种你可以直接让它挂着运行、自己去做别的事情的游戏。

items.text:
Game is broken. As a hardcore player of CDDA, I love sandboxes and this had me excited. I feel let down.

All systems it has look great on the surface, but turn out to be shallow husks.


NPCs are the worst. For example, a person can be dying right infront of you and there is no way to interact with them. There are all those traits, all those needs, those dialogue options. But all of them do absolutely nothing.

Every bit of the game from the economy to combat to ships to NPCs to quests feels like it was started and then abandoned half way.

To be honest, I never made it past the "tutorial" area of K-Leg, but I am a guy with a job and the game requires you to build a reactor of randomly appearing rare parts before you can progress further. I spent 3 real-life sessions trying to find the last one and I am just done.
items.text_zh:
游戏是坏的。作为CDDA的硬核玩家，我喜欢沙盒游戏，这款游戏曾让我很兴奋。我感到失望。

它拥有的所有系统表面上看起来都很棒，但结果却是浅薄的空壳。


NPC是最糟糕的。例如，一个人可能就快死在你的面前，而你却无法与他们互动。有那么多特质、那么多需求、那么多对话选项。但所有这些都完全不起作用。

从经济到战斗，从飞船到NPC再到任务，游戏的每一部分都感觉像是开了个头，然后半途而废。

说实话，我从未通过K-Leg的“教程”区域，但我是一个有工作的人，而游戏要求你在继续推进之前，用随机出现的稀有部件建造一个反应堆。我花了三次现实生活中的游戏时段试图找到最后一个部件，我实在受够了。

observations.description: NPC濒死时无法互动，所有特质、需求和对话选项都无效。

items.text:
Devs apparently bit off more than they could chew. The concept is somewhere halfway between Rings of Saturn and a single-player Space Station 13, which I am absolutely in love with. The execution is also only about halfway there, yet another game "released" into a disastrous clearly-not-actually-1.0.

There is [i]extreme[/i] granularity in some areas (such as building and repairing your ship) and very little in others. It lacks depth, but still might be enough if you really, really enjoy EVA derelict scavenging. Unfortunately it's also still held together with duct tape and baling wire, particularly where NPC's are concerned.

I wouldn't consider it a writeoff, and the pace of updates thankfully hasn't dried up yet. If it continues to get a reliable stream of bugfixes for another year or two I might even recommend it at some point. But as-is...it's an extremely sparse genre and this definitely brings [i]something[/i] to the table. It's unfortunate that that something still needs a lot more time in the oven.
items.text_zh:
开发者们显然贪多嚼不烂。这个概念介于《土星环》和单人版《太空站13》之间，我对此绝对爱不释手。执行方面也只做到了一半，又是一款“发布”后一塌糊涂、显然并非真正1.0的游戏。

在某些方面（比如建造和修理你的飞船）有着[i]极其[/i]细致的粒度，而在其他方面却少得可怜。它缺乏深度，但如果你真的、真的喜欢EVA废弃飞船 scavenging，那可能还是够的。不幸的是，它仍然是用胶带和捆扎铁丝勉强拼凑起来的，尤其是在NPC方面。

我不会认为它完全没救，而且谢天谢地，更新的节奏还没有枯竭。如果它能在接下来一两年里继续获得可靠的bug修复流，我甚至可能在某个时候推荐它。但就目前而言……这是一个极其稀疏的类型，而这款游戏确实带来了[i]一些东西[/i]。不幸的是，那些东西还需要在烤箱里多烤很长时间。

observations.description: 游戏缺乏深度，部分区域细节过多而其他区域细节很少
observations.evidence: It lacks depth
observations.evidence_zh: 它缺乏深度

items.text: Game is a solar system wide and an inch thick. It's repetitive and you really have to like the concept of doing something again and again, ideally with a video on the other screen. Nothing is really that challenging except the first time, a lot of features seem half baked, and most people apparently never leave the starting zone. There was a point where I was astonished about how many hours I have because it did not feel like I had that many hours of accomplishment. I managed to escape the starting zone, get a ship to visit other parts of the system, and basically see all the things in the trailer.
items.text_zh: 游戏有一个太阳系那么宽，却只有一英寸厚。它很重复，你真的必须喜欢一遍又一遍做某件事的概念，最好另一块屏幕上还放着视频。除了第一次之外，没有什么真正具有挑战性，很多功能似乎都半生不熟，而且大多数人显然从未离开过起始区域。曾经有一刻，我对自己有这么多小时感到震惊，因为感觉并没有那么多小时的成就感。我设法逃离了起始区域，弄到一艘船去访问星系的其他部分，基本上看到了预告片里的所有东西。

observations.description: 游戏重复性高，缺乏挑战
observations.evidence: It's repetitive and you really have to like the concept of doing something again and again
observations.evidence_zh: 它很重复，你真的必须喜欢一遍又一遍做同一件事的概念

observations.description: 许多功能半成品
observations.evidence: a lot of features seem half baked
observations.evidence_zh: 很多功能似乎都半生不熟

items.text: I bought this game years ago, hoping that when it came out in 1.0, it would be something else, an experience. I can’t find anywhere else in the gaming market right now. Sad to say I am severely disappointed. I don’t really understand how this can be considered a 1.0 release when so many parts of the game are either bare-bones or completely irrelevant. So many of the stations in the game have cookie-cutter layouts, the social combat is convoluted and doesn’t even matter in the end anyways, much less actual combat… as a friend said to me it is a shame because this game is supposed to scratch the itch for a star citizen sort of simulator; it completely fails in that regard once you get past the admittedly engaging initial gameplay loop. I want to say that this game will be good one day, but I don’t really know about that.
items.text_zh: 我几年前就买了这款游戏，希望当它推出1.0版本时，它会与众不同，成为一种体验。目前在游戏市场上我找不到其他地方能有这样的东西。遗憾的是，我不得不说自己非常失望。我真的不明白，当游戏的这么多部分要么是简陋的骨架，要么完全无关紧要时，这怎么能被视为1.0正式版。游戏里那么多空间站的布局都是千篇一律的，社交战斗既复杂难懂，到最后也根本无关紧要，更别提真正的战斗了……就像一位朋友对我说的，这很可惜，因为这款游戏本应满足那种类似《星际公民》模拟器的渴望；但一旦你度过了最初确实引人入胜的游戏循环，它在这一点上就彻底失败了。我想说这款游戏总有一天会变好，但我真的不太确定。

observations.description: 社交战斗系统复杂且最终无关紧要
observations.evidence: the social combat is convoluted and doesn’t even matter in the end anyways
observations.evidence_zh: 社交战斗既晦涩难懂，到最后也根本无关紧要

items.text:
I tried a session years ago (around 5 hrs). UI gave some problems, so I decided to put it off, until they finished the game. Well, it's 1.0, another 5 hrs, and oh boy.

While some of the UI issues have gotten better, UI is still illegible in many ways. Why are some items "pristine" and others not?  It obviously isn't item durability, as I have seen pristine items that have been torn apart down to 30% or less. Repairing it to full, 100% doesn't make it either. No rhyme or reason. Then there is how little oversight one has over what each stat does, what your traits do, what your skills do, etc. Sure I can see that over time I do repairs quicker, I install and uninstall items quicker, after some time. But there is nothing telling me why that is. If not for the wiki, I would have no clue what "security threshold" even means.

Speaking of the wiki, it felt like a shot in the nuts, when I discovered that a 1.0 game has so little variety. Ok, you upgrade from a screwdriver to a power tool. What's next? This is 50 years in the future. The one upgrade path, that is somewhat fully developed is the one that is about structure cutting. You go from a hacksaw, to an angle grinder, to a laser torch. Everything else? 2 or even just 1 tool only. The PDA neglect is the worst part of it. There are multiple cartriges that you are supposed to be able to slot in. Two slots only though. But over 5 cards. So you are stuck constantly switching around, depending on what you need to be able to see at that moment. These are just the tools you use directly.  

What about the ship? You use the same nav console that EVERYONE USES. There is only one. You use the exact same thruster, so on and so forth. There are only two items that actually have some variety: sensors and floors/walls. You are able to choose from around 10 sensors and there are, what feels like, over 40+ floor tiles. You also get some choice in clothing (which doesn't matter, because you spend so much time doing EVA anyways, thus you aren't seeing it). To be clear, this wouldn't be an issue, if everyone item wasn't branded with a manufacturer label. Rimworlod has one console and nobody cares. But when you have "Polaris "Standard Navigation Console" Nav Station" as your nav console, well then suddenly it becomes a question of why nobody else is in that business.  There are multiple tool businesses, why not multiple nav consoles?

Overall game progression feels grindy and tedious, while also being rather straightforward and linear. Would not recommend.
items.text_zh:
我几年前试玩过一次（大约5小时）。UI出了一些问题，所以我决定推迟，等他们完成游戏再说。好吧，现在是1.0版，又玩了5小时，我的天哪。

虽然一些UI问题有所改善，但UI在很多方面仍然难以辨认。为什么有些物品是“完好”的，而另一些不是？这显然不是物品耐久度，因为我见过被拆解到30%或更低的完好物品。把它修到满，100%也不行。毫无规律可言。然后是对每个属性做什么、你的特质做什么、你的技能做什么等等，几乎没有监督。当然，我能看到随着时间推移，我修理得更快，安装和卸载物品也更快。但没有任何东西告诉我为什么。如果不是因为wiki，我根本不知道“安全阈值”是什么意思。

说到wiki，当我发现一个1.0游戏的变化如此之少时，感觉就像蛋上挨了一枪。好吧，你从螺丝刀升级到电动工具。接下来呢？这是50年后的未来。唯一一条某种程度上完整开发的升级路径，是关于结构切割的那条。你从钢锯，到角磨机，再到激光炬。其他一切呢？只有2个甚至只有1个工具。对PDA的忽视是最糟糕的部分。有多个卡带，你本应能够插入。但只有两个插槽。却有超过5张卡。所以你只能根据当时需要看到什么而不断切换。这些还只是你直接使用的工具。

那飞船呢？你使用的是每个人都使用的同一个导航控制台。只有一个。你使用完全相同的推进器，等等等等。只有两样物品真正有一些变化：传感器和地板/墙壁。你可以从大约10种传感器中选择，还有感觉超过40多种的地板砖。你在服装上也有一些选择（这无关紧要，因为你花那么多时间做EVA，所以你看不到它）。说清楚点，如果每件物品没有都贴上制造商标签，这不会是个问题。Rimworld有一个控制台，没人在乎。但当你的导航控制台是“Polaris‘标准导航控制台’导航站”时，好吧，那突然就变成了为什么没有其他公司做这个生意的问题。有多个工具企业，为什么不能有多个导航控制台？

整体游戏进程感觉既肝又乏味，同时还相当直接和线性。不推荐。

items.text: This game is not for everyone, many systems are unintuitive or frustrating, and others are buggy or unpolished.  However, I have put 200 hours into it, and can say that it scratches the itch for a complex space game with customizable ships and living quarters.  It could use alot of polish, and I must say that I think 1.0 could have been put off until that polish was there, but if you are patient enough the game is pretty relaxing.

items.text:
The state this is in, it should be in the middle of early access with 2-3 years still to go. Instead, they slapped 1.0 on it. Sure, they claim they'll add more updates, but it's hard to take such claims seriously - surely, if they intended to add substantial features, they wouldn't have left EA, right?

The game is very buggy in numerous areas, the conversation system is possibly the worst one ever created in the history of video games (just pure, dull tedium), and the entire game is puddle deep. You spend dozens of hours salvaging ship parts (the SAME ship parts over and over, since there aren't that many of them, by the way) with the only meaningful progression offered to you being the ability to upgrade your ship. You do that, finally manage to look around the system, and... find more of the same for the most part, really. Sure, you can do some trading (who cares tbh) and fighting or asteroid mining (if you spend dozens more hours on top to get to that), but it's all taking place in a DEAD world where nothing matters and everything is faked. NPCs routinely suffocate to death in their space suits inside the station because they're THAT stupid, and nobody cares, their bodies eventually despawn and they're replaced by other randomly generated NPCs. Your interaction with the world boils down to buying and selling stuff for the most part, and there's little to no story to provide variety to it. There's no real point to the game, nothing to really strive for, and the gameplay quickly becomes stale as you're caught in a repetitive grind for cash that you don't even really need that much.

It's fun when you're starting out and finding your bearings, before the grind sets in, but that's about it, really. A wasted potential kind of game. I cannot recommend this to anyone.
items.text_zh:
它现在的状态，本应处于抢先体验阶段，而且还得再等两三年。可他们却直接给它贴上了1.0的标签。当然，他们声称还会推出更多更新，但这种说法很难让人当真——如果他们真打算加入实质性的功能，肯定不会离开抢先体验阶段，对吧？

游戏在很多方面都bug频出，对话系统可能是电子游戏史上最糟糕的（纯粹是枯燥乏味的折磨），整个游戏浅薄得像一滩水。你花上几十个小时打捞飞船部件（顺便说一句，还是同样的部件一遍又一遍，因为本来就没多少种），唯一有意义的进展就是升级你的飞船。你升级完了，终于能环顾星系了，然后……发现大部分地方还是老样子，真的。当然，你可以做些贸易（说实话谁在乎啊）和战斗或者小行星采矿（如果你再花上几十个小时才能达到那一步的话），但这一切都发生在一个死寂的世界里，什么都不重要，一切都是假的。NPC们经常在空间站里穿着宇航服窒息而死，因为他们就是那么蠢，没人在乎，他们的尸体会最终消失，然后被其他随机生成的NPC取代。你和世界的互动基本上就是买卖东西，几乎没有故事来提供多样性。游戏没有真正的目标，没有什么值得追求的东西，玩法很快就变得陈旧，因为你陷入了一种重复的刷钱循环，而你其实并不那么需要钱。

刚开始玩、还在摸索的时候挺有趣的，在刷的循环开始之前，但也就仅此而已了，真的。一款潜力被浪费的游戏。我无法向任何人推荐它。

items.text:
A foundationally disappointing launch out of early access. Many of the reviews you've already read have probably brought attention to the various bugs and performance issues, or how most of the depth of the game is only skin deep, but I'd like to explicitly focus on something you've probably read, that the game mostly forces you into the salvager/ship tinkerer role just by sort of lacking much reward to doing anything else. The reason I want to focus on that is that its easy to look at the reviews and say "Well ok so the sandbox isn't the greatest, but building my own ship would probably be pretty cool".

The problem with that is, you don't really get much in the way of actual decisions. You'll probably start just running a ship on batteries and cold gas to move around locally, and upgrade later to add fusion power and a fusion torch drive. But there's only one reactor and only one drive, you're not making decisions around performance and cost and other such tradeoffs. Same goes for your batteries, there's just smaller or bigger. Other parts, like thrusters and sensors, offer an illusion of choice between two options, but have no real difference. The closest you get to progression is ship weapons, where there's a few linear upgrades for things like PDC's. But that's it.

If you're looking for some level of actual ship simulation in your spaceship building, its not here. This isn't a cool ship builder with a lacking world to use the ship in, its just lacking, all facets.
items.text_zh:
一次从抢先体验阶段推出的、从根本上令人失望的发售。你已经读过的许多评测很可能已经指出了各种bug和性能问题，或者游戏的大部分深度只是浮于表面，但我想明确聚焦于一件你可能已经读到过的事，那就是游戏基本上迫使你进入打捞者/飞船修理工的角色，仅仅是因为做其他任何事情都缺乏足够的回报。我想聚焦于此的原因是，人们很容易看着这些评测说：“好吧，所以沙盒不是最棒的，但建造我自己的飞船大概会挺酷的。”

问题在于，你实际上并不会面临多少真正的决策。你很可能一开始只是用电池和冷气体驱动一艘飞船在本地移动，之后再升级，加入聚变电力和聚变火炬推进器。但反应堆只有一个，推进器也只有一个，你并不是在围绕性能、成本以及其他此类权衡来做决策。你的电池也一样，只是更小或更大而已。其他部件，比如推进器和传感器，提供了在两种选项之间做选择的假象，但并没有真正的区别。你最接近 progression 的地方是飞船武器，那里有一些像PDC这样的线性升级。但也就仅此而已。

如果你希望在飞船建造中体验到某种程度的真实飞船模拟，那这里没有。这不是一个很酷的飞船建造器配上一个缺乏内容的世界来使用飞船，它只是缺乏内容，所有方面都缺乏。

items.text:
[h1] A heartbreaking waste of potential [/h1]
[b] TLDR Review: [/b] Not worth your money.

This is one of those reviews that hurts to write, truly. At a glance Ostranauts looks like an awesome game, at a glance this game looks like a GOAT in the making, at a glance this game [b] [i] should [/i] [/b] be a blast but it's just not, and sadly it's much worse than it first looks like at first glance.

There are so many issues, ranging from small, to litterally fundamental to the game's conception that I couldn't possibly list them all, so instead I'm going to hammer on the main points that I think need to be addressed. With that said, here goes.

[h2] What is wrong? [/h2]
Like I mentioned, it's a lot, but let me start with the main thing that does this game in for me, the game design itself. Now, that might sound harsh, and yes, it is, however let me explain what I mean, and why I'm so irked by this.

[h3] Pain Point #1 - A false sandbox [/h3]
So here's the first thing, Ostranauts is presented as a kind of hardcore sandbox space sim, a game in which you have to sit down and seriously consider your intentions, weigh your options, and take decisions that affect your life a spacer. Sounds cool, sounds awesome even, sign me up, I want this.

Here's the problem, all of that doesn't matter, at all, let me explain. The problem is that the salvaging gameplay loop that is intended to get you out of debt and onto Venus ends up becoming the only thing really worth doing at all, because once you do end up going to other planets the other options just can't compete, for instance trading has a pretty large buy in and can only really compete if market conditions align well, racing doesn't even scratch the surface, and mining isn't really worth it either. Now, people might want to point out "The Gigs though?", however the problem there is that the more profiatble gigs have an even bigger buy in to be profitable since they require you to build for speed in order to cash in the big bucks. As a result, you effectively become locked into salvaging gameplay for the early game AND the mid-game, with a possibility of making some okay money on an occassional trade when the stars align.

This in turn creates several problems, first is that it means that litterally every single character you make will start the game in the exact same way. Second is that it means that you end up not being able to actually experiment with different ways to play the game until you are well into a save already, at which point you are already optimized for salvaging. The third issue is that those two issues thus effectively push you towards pursuing the end-game content instead, since the mid-game content (mining, trading, racing) just isn't really worth it time/money wise in most cases. Lastly, this also essentially also kills much of they joy with character creation, since the only real skills that matter are hacking, zero-g ops, and eva specialization, in that order, every time.

All of this stemming from 1 bad decision, namely forcing the player to start as a salvager, and not giving them any other options at the start. Consider if instead the player could partake in salvaging, mining, racing, piracy, and anti-piracy early on? All of a sudden your character creation options matter. If you were able to join law enforcement or become a pirate in the early game, then combat skills would matter in the early game. If you were able to begin racing then navigational skills matter. If you were able to begin mining then mining skills matter, so on and so forth. Instead, we're left with this, truth be told, depressingly bad design choice of limiting the player to "the one thing" and nothing else.

This kind of railroad-y design unfortunately permeates the entire game, if you can do something, there's one way of doing it and no more, and most of the things you'd want to be able to do, you just can't even do at all.

[h3] Pain Point #2 - Poorly thought out and implemented systems [/h3]
The next thing that really detracts from the experience is just how disjointed the various gameplay systems are, wether poorly designed, poorly implemented, or both, Ostranauts suffers from a bad case of the player having to "fight the game" to do what they want to do in many cases. For example, if you try to rebuild your ship at a station, the Crew AI will continually walk out of the airlocks without a helmet on while on auto-task, forcing you to save them, wasting your time. At the same time, they'll refuse to do certain tasks and complain about needing EVA helmets [b] when they are already f**king wearing them [/b] and stuff like this is [b] CONSTANT[/b]. For every enjoyable moment in Ostranauts, you will have 9 others that are just frustrating, annoying, or worse.

The Crew AI in general is just a pain to manage, from their overall behaviour, to only really being able to see one crew member's needs at a time, to their behaviour when it comes to zones, to how they consistently walk outside without a helmet, it all just serves to frustrate you instead of invite deeper engagement with the system.

Another thing that "sounds cool on paper, but was implemented poorly" is the interactions system, save for a specific interaction with law enforcement, and getting better hiring prices, friendship and other relationship milestones don't really matter.

[h3] Pain Point #3 - "It doesn't matter" [/h3]
This is probably the main crux of my gripes with this game, very little that you do as a player actually matters, for a game with at first glance seemingly such potential for player driven interaction, emergent gameplay, and meaningful player agency, it has almost none of it. You're railroaded into the salvager > trader/miner/racer > combat progression, and while sure you can stop at any point in that progression, that really just means you don't get any more gameplay. Initially you're driven by a need to repay debt, but that debt will clear pretty quickly once you start salvaging smart and your ship grows so you can salvage in larger quantity too.

Combine that with the fact that most POI's are mostly empty, and with nothing really unique going on, and the issues outlined in #1 & #2 really just end up creating this feeling of apathy towards the world in general, which is sad, because the ship building and piloting is actually pretty cool.

[h3] Pain Point #4 - A sandbox game trying to serve you a story [/h3]
This I think feels more like the Developers salting the wound than anything else. You've got this wonderful setup for a sandbox game, you've got the ship building, you've got the piloting, you've got a moderately interesting character creation system, and then... you build a mostly empty world, railroad the player harder than some story driven games I've played, and make any real build beyond "Hacker with EVA Skills" litterally worthless. And then, the icing on the cake on top of that, they tack on story content that most people don't care about. Like f**k man, you were the supposed to be an emergent story & gameplay type of offering, not yet another linear story space sim.

[h3] Closing thoughts [/h3]
Ultimately, Ostranauts promises big and delivers very little, and as someone who can see the potential of the idea that hurts to see, a lot. One or two good ideas is not enough to make a game, and Ostranauts is a good example of that. Now granted, I don't think that this game beyond saving, but this is not a 1.0 game, and we're probably talking a good two years or so of contuinous work to turn this around.

[h3] Final Verdict - [b] Not worth your money [/b] [/h3]
I hope that sometime in the future, perhaps in a year or two, I can buy this game again, and revisit this review, but until the Devs sit down and have a long, hard talk with themselves, and start making sweeping changes to the gameplay and especially progression structure in favor of player agency, then I cannot in good faith recommend this game to anyone at all, sadly.
items.text_zh:
[h1] 令人心碎地浪费潜力 [/h1]
[b] 简评： [/b] 不值得你花钱。

这是那种写起来很痛的评测，真的。乍一看 Ostranauts 像是一款很棒的游戏，乍一看这款游戏像是正在成形的 GOAT，乍一看这款游戏 [b] [i] 应该 [/i] [/b] 会很好玩，但它就是不好玩，而且遗憾的是，它比乍一看时糟糕得多。

问题太多了，从小问题，到对游戏构想来说简直根本性的问题，我不可能把它们全列出来，所以我要重点敲打我认為需要解决的主要几点。话虽如此，开始吧。

[h2] 哪里出了问题？ [/h2]
就像我提到的，问题很多，但让我从对我来说毁掉这款游戏的主要原因说起，也就是游戏设计本身。现在，这听起来可能很苛刻，是的，确实苛刻，不过让我解释一下我的意思，以及我为什么对此如此恼火。

[h3] 痛点 #1 - 虚假的沙盒 [/h3]
先说第一点，Ostranauts 被呈现为一种硬核沙盒太空模拟游戏，一款你必须坐下来认真考虑自己的意图、权衡选择，并做出影响你作为太空人生活的决定的游戏。听起来很酷，听起来甚至很棒，给我报名，我想要这个。

问题在这里，所有那些都无关紧要，完全无关紧要，让我解释。问题在于，那个本意是让你摆脱债务并前往金星的打捞玩法循环，最终变成了唯一真正值得做的事情，因为一旦你真的去了其他行星，其他选项根本竞争不过，比如贸易的买入成本相当高，只有在市场条件配合得很好时才真正有竞争力，竞速连皮毛都算不上，采矿也不怎么值得。现在，人们可能会想指出“那 Gigs 呢？”，但问题在于，利润更高的 gigs 为了盈利需要更大的投入，因为它们要求你为速度而建造，才能赚到大钱。结果就是，你在前期和中期实际上都被锁死在打捞玩法里，只有在星辰对齐时偶尔做一笔贸易赚点还行的钱。

这反过来又造成了几个问题，第一是这意味着你创建的每一个角色都会以完全相同的方式开始游戏。第二是这意味着你在存档已经进行得很深入之前，实际上无法尝试不同的玩法，而到那时你已经为打捞优化好了。第三个问题是，这两个问题因此实际上把你推向追求终局内容，因为中期内容（采矿、贸易、竞速）在大多数情况下从时间/金钱角度看并不真正值得。最后，这也基本上扼杀了角色创建的大部分乐趣，因为唯一真正重要的技能是黑客、零重力操作和 EVA 专精，按这个顺序，每次都是。

所有这一切都源于 1 个糟糕的决定，也就是强迫玩家以打捞者身份开局，并且一开始不给他们任何其他选择。试想一下，如果玩家一开始就能参与打捞、采矿、竞速、海盗和反海盗呢？突然之间，你的角色创建选项就有意义了。如果你能在前期加入执法部门或成为海盗，那么战斗技能在前期就有意义。如果你能开始竞速，那么导航技能就有意义。如果你 
能够开始采矿，那么采矿技能就重要了，以此类推。相反，我们得到的却是这个，说实话，令人沮丧的糟糕设计选择，把玩家限制在“唯一的一件事”上，别的什么都不行。

这种铁轨式的设计不幸地渗透了整个游戏，如果你能做某件事，那就只有一种做法，没有别的，而大多数你想做的事情，你根本连做都做不了。

[h3] 痛点 #2 - 考虑不周且实现糟糕的系统 [/h3]
下一个真正损害体验的地方，就是各种玩法系统之间有多么脱节，无论是设计糟糕、实现糟糕，还是两者兼有，Ostranauts 都患上了严重的毛病：在很多情况下，玩家为了做自己想做的事，不得不“和游戏对抗”。例如，如果你试图在空间站重建你的飞船，船员 AI 会在自动执行任务时不断不戴头盔走出气闸，逼着你去救他们，浪费你的时间。与此同时，他们会拒绝执行某些任务，并抱怨需要 EVA 头盔，[b]而他们他妈的已经戴着了[/b]，诸如此类的事情[b]层出不穷[/b]。在 Ostranauts 中，每有一个愉快的时刻，就会有另外 9 个只是令人沮丧、恼火，或者更糟的时刻。

总体而言，船员 AI 管理起来就是一件痛苦的事，从他们的整体行为，到一次只能真正看到一个船员的需求，到他们在区域方面的行为，再到他们总是能不戴头盔走到外面，这一切都只会让你感到挫败，而不是邀请你更深入地参与这个系统。

另一件“纸面上听起来很酷，但实现得很糟糕”的东西是互动系统，除了与执法部门的一个特定互动，以及获得更好的雇佣价格之外，友谊和其他关系里程碑其实并不重要。

[h3] 痛点 #3 - “这根本不重要” [/h3]
这可能是我对这款游戏不满的主要症结，作为玩家，你所做的很少真正重要，对于一款乍看之下似乎有如此潜力实现玩家驱动互动、涌现式玩法以及有意义的玩家能动性的游戏来说，它几乎一点都没有。你被强行推入打捞者 > 商人/矿工/赛车手 > 战斗的进程，当然你可以在这一进程中的任何一点停下来，但那实际上只意味着你再也得不到更多玩法了。起初你被偿还债务的需求驱动，但一旦你开始聪明地打捞，那笔债务很快就会还清，而且你的飞船也会成长，于是你也能更大批量地打捞。

再结合大多数兴趣点基本都是空的，而且没有什么真正独特的事情发生，再加上 #1 和 #2 中概述的问题，最终真的只会让人对这个世界产生一种冷漠感，这很可悲，因为飞船建造和驾驶其实相当酷。

[h3] 痛点 #4 - 一款试图给你端上剧情的沙盒游戏 [/h3]
我觉得这更像是开发者在伤口上撒盐，而不是别的什么。你有一个绝佳的沙盒游戏框架，你有飞船建造，你有驾驶，你有一个还算有趣的角色创建系统，然后……你建造了一个基本空无一物的世界，把玩家强行推得比我玩过的一些剧情驱动游戏还厉害，并让任何真正超出“带 EVA 技能的黑客”的构筑都变得毫无价值。然后，在此之上锦上添花的是，他们还硬塞上大多数人根本不在乎的剧情内容。
搞什么鬼啊，老兄，你本该是一款涌现式故事与玩法类型的作品，而不是又一个线性剧情的太空模拟游戏。

[h3] 结语 [/h3]
最终，Ostranauts 承诺了很多，兑现的却极少，而作为一个能看出这个点子潜力的人，看到这一点让我非常痛心，非常痛。一两个好点子不足以做成一款游戏，Ostranauts 就是一个很好的例子。当然，我不认为这款游戏已经无可救药，但这不是一款 1.0 游戏，我们大概需要持续工作两年左右才能扭转局面。

[h3] 最终裁决 - [b] 不值得你花钱 [/b] [/h3]
我希望在未来的某个时候，也许一两年后，我能再次买下这款游戏，并重新审视这篇评测，但在开发者坐下来跟自己进行一场漫长而艰难的谈话，并开始对玩法、尤其是进度结构进行大刀阔斧的改动，以利于玩家自主权之前，我无法凭良心向任何人推荐这款游戏，很遗憾。

items.text:
Before I start this review I want to say that I dont think this game is passionless slop.

Ostranauts is a game which I sunk 14 hours into a playthrough for, with more hours in total from pirated copies. Yet ive really not seen anything too interesting, which is weird. Instead ive spent a bunch of time watching my character uninstall some scrap. Then dragging it back to my ugly (im aware it makes sense in universe but its still true) ship, flying back to a station, and selling it. I really dont have anything too interesting to spend my money on so I just put it back into my mortgage.

And thats a problem because scrapping ships seems to be the main gameplay element in this game. Yet its boring, at least its boring for the first 14 HOURS, none of which was spent fiddling with any controls. I never encountered a ship where there was, I dont know, crazy cultists, haywire defense systems, aliens, parasites, ANYTHING. Not even a room that was pressurized and so opening it will pull air in and hurt me. Oh, its a nuclear reactor, clearly uninstalling this unprepared will kill me, right? Nope, I just right click, press uninstall, and thats it. 

Thats what you do to everything, right click, press uninstall, some items can get damaged by uninstalling (like transponders) so clearly I need to prepare more and uninstall it more care- nope, its just rng, you just save scum it. Literally everything behaves the exact same and its so dull. Keep in mind im anxious as all heck, if there were one singular instance of ANYTHING happening id be scared for the rest of my playthrough.

This is related to the biggest thing lacking in this game, atmosphere. At least while on the vessels you are intended to scrap, theres nothing. The sound design is uninteresting. you never hear the ship creaking and threatening to break apart. You hear nothing. Sure it might be realistic but who cares about realism, realism serves to make the gameplay more involved or interesting, not to strip back interesting elements (insert the todd howard saying "oh starfield is realistic IRL you woudnt find anything on random planets).

The game is dystopian in name only. What happens when I dock, surely some guy holds me up for two hours unless I have money or "know someone", right? Nope, you dock perfectly fine with no holdups. Okay but clearly someones going to hold my ship hostage and make me pay a fee, right? Nope. You get charged very reasonable docking fees. You buy salvage passes to make sure you are legally allowed to salvage. So at some point a cop is going to run around and demand your salvage pass before tearing it up and saying that he will do you a favour and let you off this time (for a small fee, of course.) Nope. If you have a salvage pass no one bugs you.

Alright, so maybe not the corruption angle, maybe just the corporate greed angle (clearly something the game wants you to think). So I should start the game with just like, INSURMOUNTABLE amounts of debt from the corpos but nope, just your mortgage. When I fly back I should just be saddled with INSANE tacked on fees, fees for convenience, fees for administrative slop, fees that arent actually for anything. so on and so on. I'm not even being creative, thats just IRL ticketmaster. IRL ticketmaster is more of a dystopia than the fictional videogame. 

Also theres an achievement named 16 tons, and you get it from getting scrip, I dont have it. Why dont I have it. Scrip should really, be the DEFAULT METHOD of payment, the company store should be trying to OWN ME. Yet I get payed in normal legal tender I can use anywhere. Like whats the point.

This is all to say that despite the fact ostronauts claims to be a dystopian society, it really isnt, like theres really NOTHING dystopian here, other than some small annoying fees, sometimes. Like cmon, be a dystopia, not just like, capitalism but honestly less bad than right now for the most part.

Yeah sure maybe the game gets more interesting when you invest the time into building a torch reactor and flying far. But thats just annoying. The shipbuilding in this game is annoying and you have very little in game motivation to buypass it. You click to place where floors and walls should be and watch as your guy SLOWLY places them. Then if you would want that room to be survivable you need to install air and N2 and heating and cooling and all of that tied to thermostats and Blah Blah Blah. Its annoying and boring, and before you say "oh you just dont like building spacecraft" and true enough its not my favourite thing but at the same time ive played a large amount of KSP and enjoyed it. If this game just had an ACTUAL ship editor where I can place down what I want and I get an itemized list of what im missing this system would be WAAAY better. Also let me buy more floors and walls. 

You can just say "oh you have no patience" and sure, I don't. I've also put hundreds of hours into My Summer Car, a game that advertises itself as "not fun" I love stalker gamma, a game where getting a new weapon WILL take hours. I've played stalker mods that are extremely slow. But I enjoyed them because they gave me unique experiences, stories. The story of the brain scorcher raid. The story of me winning the rally. The story of me completing one quest (looking at you NLC 7, no one will no what that is). This game has given me one story (for like 99% of my playtime)

The story of docking with a ship, pressing right click to uninstall, and dragging it back.

Sure theres gigs and bounties, I BUILT MY ENTIRE CURRENT CHARACTER AROUND DOING THEM but they still just serve as supplementary income. Not to mention bounties are just, broken, you just show me a ship with no location info. I really cant do anything with this, apparently according to a guide I install a radar and sort through like, 100 ships, like really, is that exciting? 

Overall, ostronauts is tedious, boring, and not worth playing for most people. Thumbs down, I do not recommend
items.text_zh:
在我开始这篇评测之前，我想说我不认为这款游戏是没有热情的垃圾。

Ostranauts 是一款我投入了14个小时进行一周目游玩的游戏，加上盗版副本的总时长还要更多。然而我真的没看到任何太有趣的东西，这很奇怪。相反，我花了一大堆时间看着我的角色拆卸一些废料。然后把它拖回我那丑陋的（我知道这在世界观里说得通，但它确实很丑）飞船，飞回空间站，然后卖掉它。我真的没有什么太有趣的东西可以花钱，所以我只能把它又投回我的抵押贷款里。

而这是个问题，因为拆解飞船似乎是这款游戏的主要玩法元素。但它很无聊，至少在前14个小时里很无聊，这期间我完全没有摆弄过任何控制装置。我从未遇到过一艘有，我不知道，疯狂邪教徒、失控防御系统、外星人、寄生虫，任何东西的飞船。甚至连一个加压的房间都没有，打开它会让空气涌入并伤到我。哦，这是核反应堆，显然毫无准备地拆卸它会杀了我，对吧？不，我只是右键点击，按下拆卸，就这样。

你对所有东西都是这么做的，右键点击，按下拆卸，有些物品在拆卸时可能会损坏（比如应答器），所以显然我需要做更多准备，更小心地拆卸它——不，这只是随机数，你只要存档读档就行了。字面意义上的所有东西行为都完全一样，而且太乏味了。记住我焦虑得要命，如果哪怕有任何一个瞬间发生了任何事情，我都会在剩下的游玩过程中一直害怕。

这与这款游戏最缺乏的东西有关，氛围。至少在你打算拆解的飞船上时，什么都没有。音效设计毫无趣味。你永远听不到飞船吱嘎作响、威胁要散架。你什么都听不到。当然这也许很真实，但谁在乎真实，真实是为了让玩法更投入或更有趣，而不是剥离有趣的元素（插入托德·霍华德说“哦《星空》很真实，在现实中你在随机星球上什么都找不到”）。

这款游戏只是名义上的反乌托邦。当我停靠时会发生什么，肯定有人会拦我两个小时，除非我有钱或者“认识人”，对吧？不，你停靠得完全顺利，没有任何阻碍。好吧，但显然会有人扣押我的飞船当人质，逼我交一笔费用，对吧？不。你被收取非常合理的停靠费。你购买打捞许可证以确保你合法被允许打捞。所以到了某个时候，警察会跑来要求看你的打捞许可证，然后把它撕掉，说他会帮你个忙，这次放你一马（当然，收一小笔费用）。不。如果你有打捞许可证，没人会找你麻烦。

好吧，所以也许不是腐败的角度，也许只是企业贪婪的角度（显然是游戏想让你这么想的）。所以我应该以从公司那里欠下，就像，无法逾越的巨额债务来开始游戏，但不，只有你的抵押贷款。当我飞回来时，我应该被强加上疯狂的附加费用，便利费，行政垃圾费，实际上不为任何东西的费用。诸如此类。我甚至都不是在发挥创意，那只是现实中的Ticketmaster。现实中的Ticketmaster比这个虚构的电子游戏更像反乌托邦。

另外还有一个叫“16吨”的成就，你通过获得代币券来得到它，我没有它。为什么我没有它。代币券真的应该，是默认的支付方式，公司商店应该试图拥有我。然而我拿到的是可以在任何地方使用的正常法定货币。那有什么意义。

这一切都是为了说明，尽管Ostranauts声称是一个反乌托邦社会，它真的不是，就像这里真的没有任何反乌托邦的东西，除了一些小的烦人费用，有时候。就像拜托，做个反乌托邦吧，而不只是，资本主义，但老实说大部分时候比现在还不糟糕。

是的，当然也许当你投入时间建造火炬反应堆并飞得很远时，游戏会变得更有趣。但那只是烦人。这款游戏里的造船很烦人，而且你在游戏里几乎没有动力去绕过它。你点击放置地板和墙壁应该在哪里，然后看着你的角色慢慢地放置它们。然后如果你想让那个房间可以生存，你需要安装空气和氮气和加热和冷却，所有这些都连接到恒温器上，等等等等。这很烦人又无聊，在你之前说“哦你只是不喜欢建造航天器”之前，确实它不是我最喜欢的事情，但与此同时我玩过大量的KSP并且很享受。如果这款游戏只是有一个真正的飞船编辑器，我可以在那里放下我想要的东西，然后得到一份我缺少什么的逐项清单，这个系统会好得多。另外让我买更多的地板和墙壁。

你可以直接说“哦你没有耐心”，确实，我没有。我也在《我的夏季汽车》里投入了数百小时，一款自我宣传为“不好玩”的游戏。我喜欢《潜行者》GAMMA，一款获得新武器会花费数小时的游戏。我玩过极其缓慢的《潜行者》模组。但我享受它们，因为它们给了我独特的体验、故事。脑灼烧器突袭的故事。我赢得拉力赛的故事。我完成一个任务的故事（说的就是你NLC 7，没人会知道那是什么）。这款游戏给了我一个故事（在我大约99%的游玩时间里）

与一艘飞船停靠，按下右键拆卸，然后把它拖回来的故事。

当然有零工和赏金，我围绕做这些构建了我当前整个角色，但它们仍然只是作为补充收入。更不用说赏金只是，坏掉了，你只是给我看一艘没有位置信息的飞船。我真的对此无能为力，显然根据一份指南，我安装一个雷达然后筛选大约100艘飞船，真的，那很刺激吗？

总的来说，Ostranauts是乏味的、无聊的，对大多数人来说不值得玩。差评，我不推荐
在我开始这篇评测之前，我想说我不认为这款游戏是无爱的垃圾。

《Ostranauts》是一款我投入了14个小时进行一周目游玩的游戏，加上盗版副本的总时长还要更多。然而我真的没看到什么太有趣的东西，这很奇怪。相反，我花了一大堆时间看着我的角色拆卸一些废料。然后把它拖回我那艘丑陋的（我知道这在世界观里说得通，但它确实很丑）飞船，飞回空间站，然后卖掉它。我真的没有什么太有趣的东西可以花钱，所以我只能把它投回我的房贷里。

而这是个问题，因为拆解飞船似乎是这款游戏的主要玩法元素。但它很无聊，至少前14个小时是无聊的，这期间我一点都没花时间摆弄任何控制。我从未遇到过一艘有，我不知道，疯狂邪教徒、失控防御系统、外星人、寄生虫、任何东西的飞船。甚至连一个加压的房间都没有，打开它会把空气吸进去然后伤到我。哦，这是个核反应堆，显然毫无准备地拆卸它会杀了我，对吧？不，我只需右键点击，按下卸载，就这样。

你对所有东西都是这么做的，右键点击，按下卸载，有些物品在卸载时可能会损坏（比如应答器），所以显然我需要做更多准备，更小心地卸载它——不，这只是随机数，你只要存档读档就行了。字面意义上的所有东西行为都一模一样，太乏味了。记住我焦虑得要命，如果哪怕有任何一个任何事发生的例子，我都会在剩下的游玩过程中一直害怕。

这与这款游戏最缺乏的东西有关，氛围。至少在你打算拆解的飞船上，什么都没有。音效设计毫无趣味。你永远听不到飞船吱嘎作响、濒临解体。你什么都听不到。当然这也许很真实，但谁在乎真实，真实是为了让玩法更投入或更有趣，而不是剥离有趣的元素（插入托德·霍华德说“哦《星空》很真实，在现实里你在随机星球上什么都找不到”）。

这款游戏只是名义上的反乌托邦。当我停靠时会发生什么，肯定会有人拦住我两个小时，除非我有钱或者“认识人”，对吧？不，你停靠得完全顺利，没有任何阻拦。好吧，但显然会有人扣押我的飞船当人质，逼我交一笔费用，对吧？不。你被收取非常合理的停靠费。你购买打捞许可证以确保你在法律上被允许打捞。所以某个时候会有个警察跑来要求看你的打捞许可证，然后把它撕掉，说他会帮你个忙这次放你一马（当然，收一小笔费用）。不。如果你有打捞许可证，没人会来烦你。

好吧，所以也许不是腐败的角度，也许只是企业贪婪的角度（显然这是游戏想让你想的）。所以我应该以，比如，来自大公司的那种无法逾越的债务开始游戏，但不，只有你的房贷。当我飞回来时，我应该被塞上疯狂的附加费用，便利费，行政垃圾费，实际上不为任何东西的费用。如此等等。我甚至都不是在发挥创意，这就是现实中的Ticketmaster。现实中的Ticketmaster比这个虚构的电子游戏更像反乌托邦。

另外还有一个叫“16吨”的成就，你通过获得代币券来得到它，我没有它。为什么我没有它。代币券真的应该，是默认的支付方式，公司商店应该试图拥有我。然而我拿到的是我可以在任何地方使用的正常法定货币。那有什么意义。

这一切都是为了说明，尽管《Ostranauts》声称自己是一个反乌托邦社会，它其实并不是，这里真的没有任何反乌托邦的东西，除了有时候一些小小的烦人费用。拜托，做个反乌托邦吧，而不只是，资本主义，但老实说大部分时候还没现在糟糕。

是啊，当然也许当你投入时间建造一个火炬反应堆并飞得很远时，游戏会变得更有趣。但那只是烦人。这款游戏里的造船很烦人，而且你在游戏里几乎没有动力去绕过它。你点击来放置地板和墙壁应该在哪，然后看着你的角色慢慢地放置它们。然后如果你想让那个房间可以生存，你需要安装空气和氮气以及供暖和制冷，所有这些都连着恒温器，等等等等。这既烦人又无聊，在你开口说“哦你只是不喜欢建造航天器”之前，没错，这确实不是我最喜欢的事，但与此同时我玩过大量的《坎巴拉太空计划》并且很享受。如果这款游戏有一个真正的飞船编辑器，让我可以放下我想要的东西，并且给我一份我缺少什么的逐项清单，这个系统会好得多。另外让我买更多的地板和墙壁。

你大可以说“哦你没有耐心”，没错，我没有。我也在《我的夏季汽车》里投入了数百小时，一款自我宣传为“不好玩”的游戏，我喜欢《潜行者》GAMMA，一款获得新武器确实要花上数小时的游戏。我玩过极其缓慢的《潜行者》模组。但我享受它们，因为它们给了我独特的体验、故事。脑部灼烧者突袭的故事。我赢得拉力赛的故事。我完成一个任务的故事（说的就是你NLC 7，没人会知道那是什么）。这款游戏只给了我一个故事（大约占我99%的游玩时间）

那就是与一艘飞船对接，右键点击卸载，然后把它拖回来的故事。

当然有零工和赏金，我围绕做这些任务构建了我当前整个角色，但它们仍然只是作为补充收入。更别提赏金根本就是坏的，你只给我看一艘飞船，没有任何位置信息。我真的对此无能为力，显然根据一份指南我要安装一个雷达然后从大约100艘飞船里筛选，说真的，那很刺激吗？

总的来说，《Ostranauts》冗长乏味、无聊，对大多数人来说不值得一玩。差评，我不推荐

items.text:
I've followed this game's development for years. I loved Neoscavenger (the developer's last game) and a sci-fi sandbox space sim set in the same universe sounded amazing. 

I finally decided to pull the trigger and buy it, but I just cannot recommend it in its current state. I suspect that if this is what they consider a 1.0 release after half a decade of development, then these glaring issues will probably never be fully addressed.

So many of the game systems are bizarrely obtuse. For instance, your psychological needs are generally satisfied through dialogue with NPCs in a system the devs call "social combat." I'm sorry, what? This is the worst attempt at dialogue gamification since Oblivion's persuasion wheel. Worse yet, several "gigs" require you to stumble through this social combat sequence with no clear guidance, just hoping that the interaction you need pops up.

There is so much potential here. The game can be really fun at times. It's really satisfying to find a derelict with good parts, repair them, and sell them or use them to upgrade your ship. But those moments only punctuate a long, tedious slog. 

It just feels like somewhere along the way the developers forgot that they're making a game.

我关注这款游戏的开发已经好几年了。我很喜欢Neoscavenger（这位开发者的上一款游戏），而一款设定在同一宇宙中的科幻沙盒太空模拟游戏听起来太棒了。

我终于决定下定决心买下它，但我实在无法推荐它目前的状态。我怀疑，如果这就是他们开发了五年之后所认为的1.0正式版，那么这些显而易见的问题可能永远都不会被完全解决。

游戏中有太多系统晦涩得令人匪夷所思。比如说，你的心理需求通常是通过与NPC对话来满足的，开发者把这套系统称为“社交战斗”。不好意思，什么？这是自《湮灭》的说服轮盘以来对对话游戏化最糟糕的尝试。更糟的是，好几个“任务”要求你在毫无明确指引的情况下摸索着完成这套社交战斗流程，只能指望你需要的互动恰好出现。

这里面有太多潜力了。这游戏有时候真的很好玩。找到一艘带有好零件的废弃飞船，把它们修好，然后卖掉或者用来升级你的飞船，真的很有满足感。但这些时刻只是点缀在漫长而乏味的苦差事之中。

就感觉在某个环节上，开发者忘了他们是在做一款游戏。
