items.text:
Whilst this game could allow for a lot replayability it has problems.

It lacks basic features that would improve the game a lot, it is needlessly complicated in some areas and front loaded. Yet somehow shallow. It lacks info about what anything does, like player traits.

Here is some simple things, what I think it needs as a priority:
Unable to quit to main menu from character creation, in case you pressed wrong button or wanna try again. 'Continue' on titlescreen is often for continuing a last save, should probably be called 'load'.
For some reason container items need to be interacting with and you need to select 'inventory'. Look I love inventory management, heck I love CDDA, but requiring the game to be unpaused to look at your items is not good. I cannot stress the amount this reduced my enjoyment. Having to check everythings inventory is tedious.
Unable to label or change name of items, that glass bottle of 'vodka' you have for coffee? Yeah your gonna have to use the previous inventory checking each time you want to go through your stuff, as you can't tell at a glance what's in it?
Using control to pick up single items from a stack is impossible, you use control to instead 'place' one from the stack? Seems backwards.
Kicks you out of nav panel on ships when closing the ship menu, very annoying when you are learning the game and after still annoying.
No way to 'cancel' a move command easily.
The ship travel menu is a mess, trying to move around the map is sensitive and annoying, Trying to figure out your heading AND viewing your target is very difficult. This COULD be forgiven if better navigation parts are added later, but I seriously doubt such poor UI would be on every ship in galaxy. You can't even get predictions on where an object is travel that you have targeted, or even the angle between you and the target.

Other areas to improve:
The OST is not very good, it could use better music. I turned it off after a bit. The first one is good for the character creation though.
Traits that do nothing.
Poor variety of items and parts, every ship starts to look the same in terms of parts.
All ships have the same UI?
Some traits or skills aren't trainable?
Unclear to the players when stuff needs to be paid.
No 'buffer' for new characters from fees, means 100% your first character you spent time on will be a waste, should be able to 'pre' save already built characters with same parents, etc.
Changing your last name does not affect your origins.
All the 'mothers' I get look like dudes, tested 8/10 times, same with weird looking fathers. Why assign parents at all? They don't appear to affect your story in the slightest? Character creation options are limited, n general the options for females in particular are bad, I tried playing a few times and once it gave me a female character, after wasting time making a character I realised that it just puts a different face only, it kinda looks goofy on top of the default male body. But across the board it is lacking, you can't even make a character that looks like the loading screens... or even 'normal' looking.
The loan system for your ship seems a bit weird? You can loan for a $800,000 ship, but can't for a $80,000 + some extra like gear? Or a license? I dunno man. Stuff doesn't make sense, in the description of one ship it mentions you worked on it... why can't you work on the cheapest ship?
The LONG saving times, are an issue.
The character creation is sometimes annoying, 'seek ship' should not show the same ship more then once, even if it adds more time the next time you look.
NPCs steal your items? Items disappearing? Had to reload as a core item like my helmet disappeared.
Uninstalling parts in your ship and they appear outside the ship... serious issue as there is no way to go outside? Even from port?


I tried to enjoy this game as it seems to have all the elements for a game I would enjoy but it is half baked at least for now and I just don't. It ain't even that deep either, even though it seems complicated up front, once you play a little bit it is a really simple game.

Still all that said I still think this will be a good game after some updates, unfortunately from what I can see that would take at least 3 years at current rate of development to where I would consider this game playable.
items.text_zh:
虽然这款游戏可能允许大量重复游玩，但它存在问题。

它缺乏能大幅改善游戏的基础功能，在某些方面不必要地复杂且前置内容过多。然而不知怎的又很浅薄。它缺乏关于任何东西作用的说明，比如玩家特质。

以下是一些简单的事情，我认为它需要优先处理：
无法从角色创建退出到主菜单，以防你按错了按钮或想再试一次。标题画面上的“继续”通常是用来继续上次存档的，可能应该叫“加载”。
不知为何容器物品需要与之互动，然后你需要选择“库存”。听着，我喜欢库存管理，见鬼，我喜欢CDDA，但要求游戏取消暂停才能查看你的物品并不好。我无法强调这减少了我多少乐趣。不得不检查每样东西的库存很乏味。
无法给物品贴标签或更改名称，你那瓶用来配咖啡的“伏特加”玻璃瓶？是啊，每次你想翻找你的东西时，都得用之前说的检查库存，因为你无法一眼看出里面是什么？
使用control从一堆物品中拾取单个物品是不可能的，你用control反而是从堆里“放置”一个？似乎反了。
在飞船上关闭飞船菜单时，会把你踢出导航面板，在你学习游戏时非常烦人，之后仍然烦人。
没有简单的方法“取消”移动命令。
飞船旅行菜单一团糟，试图在地图上移动既敏感又烦人，试图弄清你的航向同时查看你的目标非常困难。如果以后加入更好的导航部件，这还可以原谅，但我严重怀疑银河系每艘飞船上都会有这么糟糕的UI。你甚至无法获得你所瞄准物体移动方向的预测，甚至无法获得你与目标之间的角度。

其他需要改进的地方：
原声带不太好，可以用更好的音乐。我听了一会儿就关掉了。不过第一首对角色创建来说不错。
毫无作用的特质。
物品和部件种类贫乏，每艘飞船在部件方面开始看起来都一样。
所有飞船都有相同的UI？
有些特质或技能无法训练？
玩家不清楚什么时候需要付费。
新角色没有针对费用的“缓冲”，意味着你花时间创建的第一个角色100%会白费，应该能够“预先”保存已经创建好的、拥有相同父母等的角色。
更改你的姓氏不会影响你的出身。
我得到的所有“母亲”看起来都像男人，测试了8/10次，长相奇怪的“父亲”也一样。为什么要分配父母呢？他们似乎丝毫不影响你的故事？角色创建选项有限，总的来说尤其是女性的选项很糟糕，我试玩了几次，有一次给了我一个女性角色，在浪费时间创建角色后我意识到它只是换了一张不同的脸，放在默认男性身体上看起来有点滑稽。但总体而言它很欠缺，你甚至无法创建一个看起来像加载画面里的角色……甚至看起来“正常”的都不行。
你飞船的贷款系统似乎有点奇怪？你可以贷款买一艘800,000美元的飞船，但不能贷款买一艘80,000美元加一些额外东西比如装备的？或者一张执照？我不知道，老兄。事情说不通，在一艘飞船的描述中提到你曾在它上面工作过……为什么你不能在最便宜的飞船上工作？
漫长的保存时间是个问题。
角色创建有时很烦人，“寻找飞船”应该
不要在你下次查看时再次显示同一艘飞船，即使这会增加更多时间。
NPC会偷你的物品？物品消失？不得不重新加载，因为像我的头盔这样的核心物品消失了。
卸载你飞船上的部件，它们却出现在飞船外面……严重问题，因为根本没有办法出去？甚至从港口也不行？


我试着享受这款游戏，因为它似乎具备了一款我会喜欢的游戏的所有元素，但至少目前它是半生不熟的，我就是不喜欢。它甚至也没那么有深度，尽管乍一看似乎很复杂，一旦你玩上一小会儿，它其实是一款非常简单的游戏。

尽管如此，我仍然认为在经过一些更新后这会是一款好游戏，不幸的是，据我所见，以目前的开发速度，至少需要3年才能达到我认为这款游戏可玩的程度。

items.text:
Very good concept and if completed will be an all-time favorite of mine. Currently, progress is very slow and bugs are plenty. Having companions doesn't work very well. Lots of animation work left to do. A deeper economy and ways to make money need to be added. There will most likely later be pirating, salvaging, hacking, persuasion, all as ways to "win" and become rich. Right now, it's very stale with progression coming down to fly to location - load up on scraps - fly to location - fix a bunch of parts - fly to location - sell parts. You'd have to do that loop probably 20 times, taking over an hour or two each time, to make enough to buy a new ship. Previously there was a bit of an oversight where you could buy a damaged ship, install high-grade parts on it, and sell it for a fortune. This has been fixed, and now derilect's aren't worth working on. Combat is very half baked at the moment, with a psuedo turn-based system where the real time will pause after both people have made a move. Right click on the enemy, try to tackle or shoot or hit or stab, RNG, they try to do the same to you, RNG, they damage your space suit, you suffocate, reload and skip that ship next time. Animations during combat make it nearly impossible to tell what is actually happening, no status indicators to help see who is winning or make strategic decisions. 

With the new update that got rid of derilect farming, I didn't get to buy a large ship and make it my own, but I had been able to previously, and it was an amazing experience. Hooking up power, ship systems, balancing oxygen and nitrogen, setting up fuel systems, designing storage, designing airlocks and failsafes, was all incredible fun, as is the salvaging. There just isn't enough variety or ability to build your craft out yet to make it an amazing game loop. If expanding your ship were easier, or faster, it would be a lot more friendly for longer hours. A system where you blueprint the craft additions and then your guy gets to work would be awesome, instead of manually and individually right clicking every part, waiting for deconstruct, waiting for install, right click, right click, press 1, press 2, right click, wait, right click, press 1, wait, press 2...... 

Overall worthy project of support.
items.text_zh:
非常好的概念，如果完成的话会成为我一生的最爱。目前，进展非常缓慢，bug 很多。同伴系统运作得不太好。还有大量动画工作要做。需要加入更深层的经济和赚钱方式。之后很可能会加入海盗、打捞、黑客、说服，所有这些作为“获胜”和致富的途径。现在，游戏非常乏味，进程归结为飞到地点——装载废料——飞到地点——修理一堆零件——飞到地点——卖掉零件。你大概得重复这个循环 20 次，每次花一两个小时，才能赚够钱买一艘新船。之前有一个小疏漏，你可以买一艘受损的船，给它装上高级零件，然后卖出一大笔钱。这个问题已被修复，现在废弃船不值得去弄了。战斗目前非常半成品，采用一种伪回合制系统，双方都行动后实时会暂停。右键点击敌人，尝试擒抱或射击或打击或刺击，随机数判定，他们尝试对你做同样的事，随机数判定，他们损坏你的太空服，你窒息，重新加载，下次跳过那艘船。战斗中的动画让人几乎无法分辨实际发生了什么，没有状态指示器来帮助看出谁占上风或做出战略决策。

随着新更新取消了废弃船刷钱，我没能买一艘大船并把它变成我自己的，但我之前曾经能够做到，那是一次奇妙的体验。接通电力、船舶系统、平衡氧气和氮气、设置燃料系统、设计存储、设计气闸和故障保险，全都极其有趣，打捞也是如此。只是目前还没有足够的多样性或能力来把你的飞船建造出来，使其成为一个出色的游戏循环。如果扩展你的飞船更容易或更快，对长时间游玩会友好得多。一个系统，你先为飞船增建设计蓝图，然后你的人开始工作，那会很棒，而不是手动逐个右键点击每个零件，等待拆解，等待安装，右键，右键，按 1，按 2，右键，等待，右键，按 1，等待，按 2……

总体而言，是一个值得支持的项目。

observations.description: 同伴系统运作不佳
observations.evidence: Having companions doesn't work very well.
observations.evidence_zh: 拥有同伴的效果不太好。

observations.description: 战斗系统半成品
observations.evidence: Combat is very half baked at the moment, with a psuedo turn-based system where the real time will pause after both people have made a move.
observations.evidence_zh: 战斗目前非常半生不熟，采用一种伪回合制系统，双方各行动一次后实时时间就会暂停。

items.text:
when i played the demo, years ago, i was left with a... pretty bad first impression.

the controls were wonky, the user interface was opaque, and i couldn't really tell what i was meant to be doing.

it left enough of an impression on me that even as early access progressed, even as additional updates rolled out, even as it went on sale, even as one of my friends played it and reported on what those updates played like, i kept going "..... i dunno."

then after 0.14 hit, something happened in my social circles: people started playing the game, and i got a [i]wildly[/i] different impression on the state of the game than i did even just from 0.13, the very previous update.

with the addition of venus, there was somewhere to strive to get [i]to[/i]. with the rework of the reactor system, there was something to strive to [i]have[/i]. these elements, along with a lot of other adjustments and fixes, helped provide a better framing that let all of the systems work of the previous updates suddenly be recontextualized, and now, as if by magic, we went from "a kinda interesting simulation, i guess" to [b]an actual game[/b].

is the ui still kinda opaque? yeah. are there weird systems interactions that are counterintuitive? oh yeah. are there bugs? most definitely.

but the progress i'm seeing makes me believe that the team has a better understanding of what they need to clean up for the upcoming 1.0 release, and i wanna see it happen.
items.text_zh:
当我多年前玩这个演示版时，我留下的第一印象……相当糟糕。

操作很别扭，用户界面晦涩难懂，我根本搞不清自己该做什么。

它给我留下的印象如此之深，以至于即使抢先体验不断推进，即使额外更新陆续推出，即使它开始打折，即使我的一个朋友玩了它并反馈了那些更新的游玩体验，我一直都在说“..... 我不知道。”

然后0.14版本发布后，我的社交圈里发生了一些事：人们开始玩这个游戏，而我对游戏状态的印象与仅仅从0.13，也就是上一个更新中得到的印象[i]截然不同[/i]。

随着金星的加入，有了一个可以努力[i]前往[/i]的地方。随着反应堆系统的重做，有了可以努力[i]拥有[/i]的东西。这些元素，连同许多其他调整和修复，帮助提供了一个更好的框架，让之前所有更新的系统工作突然被重新赋予了意义，而现在，仿佛魔法一般，我们从“一个还算有趣的模拟，我猜”变成了[b]一个真正的游戏[/b]。

用户界面还是有点晦涩吗？是的。有没有奇怪的系统交互让人反直觉？哦，有的。有没有bug？绝对有。

但我看到的进步让我相信，团队更清楚地知道他们需要为即将到来的1.0发布清理什么，而我想看到它实现。

observations.description: 系统交互反直觉
observations.evidence: are there weird systems interactions that are counterintuitive? oh yeah.
observations.evidence_zh: 是否存在一些反直觉的奇怪系统交互？哦，确实有。

items.text:
Okay, I have a few hours more on the list now and it's still my "home between the stars" go-to cozy game. ;)

****
♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥, what a really really great game?!? It's basically: Be a real person in space that is living on her space ship, trucking the space lanes. And you can even sit in your space kitchen made from salvage of plundered derelicts. Set your ship on a route. Leave the helm. Do things in the ship. Suddenly the alarm rings. There's wreckage on your route or you didn't watch the clock and are already a mere seconds away from crashing into Ganymed. Now run to get into the pilot seat. I love it. I'm 76 hours in. Because I was sick home last week, when I bought it!

Admittedly, there are some shadows. The UI is a little unintuitive. Left click move, right click show infos, which you get in the upper right. Then you have to look into the middle lower side of the screen to see interactions. That takes a moment to get used to it. A few other things. The AI, when you automatize crew ... uhm ... has room for improvements? The dialogue system is a hassle at it's current state. Too many options, too many repetitions. Expect bugs. Send bug reports to their discord.

But that's solvable and compared to the awesome home in space that you'll build? A small price zu pay.

EDIT: A few more hours in the game. It's still a gem, but with steadily improving UI and a decreasing number of bugs.
items.text_zh:
好吧，现在我的游戏时间又多了几个小时，它仍然是我“星际之间的家”的首选舒适游戏。;)

****
天哪，这真是一款非常非常棒的游戏？！？基本上就是：在太空中做一个真实的人，住在自己的飞船上，在太空航道上跑运输。你甚至可以坐在用掠夺废弃飞船残骸做成的太空厨房里。给你的飞船设定一条航线。离开驾驶位。在飞船里做点事。突然警报响了。你的航线上有残骸，或者你没看时间，已经离撞上木卫三只有几秒钟了。现在赶紧跑去坐到驾驶座上。我爱这个。我已经玩了76个小时。因为上周我生病在家，就买了它！

诚然，也有一些阴影。UI有点不直观。左键移动，右键显示信息，信息在右上角。然后你还得看屏幕中下方才能看到交互选项。这需要一点时间适应。还有几点别的。AI，当你自动化船员时……呃……还有改进空间？对话系统目前的状态很麻烦。选项太多，重复太多。做好遇到bug的准备。把bug报告发到他们的discord。

但这些都是可以解决的，和你将要建造的太空中的美妙家园相比？只是小小的代价。

编辑：又玩了几个小时。它仍然是一颗宝石，只是UI在稳步改进，bug数量也在减少。

observations.description: 对话系统选项过多且重复，操作繁琐
observations.evidence: The dialogue system is a hassle at it's current state. Too many options, too many repetitions.
observations.evidence_zh: 对话系统在目前状态下很麻烦。选项太多，重复太多。

items.text: It's not a bad game by any means but it has so many stuff going on at the same time and there is no pacing. You get bombarded by everything at the same time which is a nightmare. Even after playing it for some time you still have no idea whats going on. You create a character with 0 idea whats going on you get on your ship with 0 idea of whats going on. You start figuring stuff out while scavenging. You come back to the station still not knowing what you should do. Is the amount you made any good. Do i upgrade the ship. Do i keep the money for the debt? Is there a docking fee? What's an eva? Why and where do i charge it? What is a shuttle? Why is ui design so complicated? What the ♥♥♥♥ is going on with the very complicated and retarded dialogue systems. Do i dismantle or just bring the stuff in. Why is navigating the space sucks so much etc. There is a ♥♥♥♥ ton of problems. Very hostile against new player. If they don't abandon the game they will eventually figure out stuff and it will become a great game. Right now if you know what you are doing its fun but if you are not ready to watch a couple hours of videos to get ready and you are not okay with 1 mistake ruining your whole game. Don't even try it. You can softlock the game by just playing it and lose an hour of progress.
items.text_zh: 这游戏绝对不算差，但它同时有太多东西在发生，完全没有节奏。你被所有东西同时轰炸，简直是场噩梦。即使玩了一段时间，你仍然不知道发生了什么。你创建角色时完全不知道发生了什么，登上飞船时也完全不知道发生了什么。你在拾荒时开始弄明白一些事情。你回到空间站，仍然不知道应该做什么。我赚的钱够好吗？我该升级飞船吗？我该留着钱还债吗？有停靠费吗？什么是EVA？我为什么要充电，在哪里充？什么是穿梭机？为什么UI设计这么复杂？那套非常复杂又弱智的对话系统到底是怎么回事？我是拆解还是直接把东西带进来？为什么太空导航这么烂等等。问题多得要命。对新玩家非常不友好。如果他们不放弃游戏，最终会弄明白一些事情，游戏会变得很棒。现在，如果你知道自己在做什么，那很有趣，但如果你不准备看几个小时的视频来做好准备，而且你不能接受一个错误毁掉整个游戏，那就别试了。你光是玩就可能把游戏卡死，损失一个小时的进度。

observations.evidence: it has so many stuff going on at the same time and there is no pacing. You get bombarded by everything at the same time which is a nightmare.
observations.evidence_zh: 这游戏绝对不差，但同时发生的事情太多了，毫无节奏可言。你会在同一时间被所有东西轰炸，简直是场噩梦。

items.text:
For the price and enjoying 40-50hours of gameplay why not. Thats if you want to salvage ships and piece a new one together using spare parts.

Still missing features last I played, combat was a bit wonky and I think the exercise equipment had just been added so you could actually improve your character. Hopefully more of that will get fleshed out, as it didnt make too much sense that I couldnt better myself after the choose-your-own-adventure character creation.

Would be nice to see multiple ships docked at a single location to make it a bit more lively, the ability to heal those npcs that are dying, multiple level ships could be fun if the engine supports it.... maybe some larger areas to explore. A more restrained 'special event' spread... thats was getting very annoying. A form of food growing perhaps - plenty of room for additional crafting mechanics or extra items for salvage, some ships only seemed worth grabbing the engines in terms of time vs value.
items.text_zh:
就这个价格和能享受40-50小时的游戏时间来说，为什么不呢。前提是你想打捞飞船并用备件拼凑出一艘新的。

我上次玩的时候还缺少一些功能，战斗有点别扭，我记得健身器材刚加进去，这样你就能真正提升角色了。希望这些能进一步完善，因为在我自己选择冒险式的角色创建之后却不能提升自己，这不太合理。

如果能在一个地点看到多艘飞船停靠，让它更有生气就好了，能治疗那些濒死的NPC，如果引擎支持的话，多层级飞船可能会很有趣……也许还有一些更大的区域可以探索。更克制的“特殊事件”分布……那玩意儿变得非常烦人。也许可以有种种植食物的方式——有大量空间可以加入额外的制作机制或打捞物品，有些飞船从时间与价值比来看似乎只值得拿走引擎。

items.text:
I recommend this game... with a big caveat.

This game is great, I think the atmosphere is phenomenal and the gameplay loop of scavenging and upgrading a ship is really terrific. I've sunk more than 20 hours in from a dozen play sessions and I'm really satisfied with my time up until now.

I just wish someone had warned me about the [spoiler] meat [/spoiler].

I think the idea of it fits in with the story they want to tell, and I even think I could figure out the mystery of it on my own the way the game clearly wants me to, but I'm still working to get my head around a lot of the other mechanics of the game and now I feel like I've been really derailed. I tried to investigate it quietly and I've tried fighting it off and was thrashed because combat is a slog. And like, I don't want to be doing combat in a game like this if I can avoid it, so the slog feels pretty good for sparse pirate encounters, just not this. 

Other players have made mods which deactivate the [spoiler] meat [/spoiler] content (which feels pretty vindicating), but at present they can only prevent it from spawning and won't remove it from a save file that I've now poured almost 20 hours into. 

I recommend this game. Even as an early access product the salvaging stuff feels close to feature complete and I've enjoyed that. I just wish I'd had the time to really succeed at the core space salvaging experience before cracking into a game with this other layer on it. And I get that other players will enjoy it a lot more than I am right now, I just feel like it's pulled the air out of my experience with it.
items.text_zh:
我推荐这款游戏……但有一个很大的警告。

这款游戏很棒，我觉得氛围非常出色， scavenging 和升级飞船的游戏循环真的很棒。我已经玩了十几次，累计投入了 20 多个小时，到目前为止我对自己的游戏时间真的很满意。

我只是希望有人能提前警告我关于[剧透]肉[/剧透]的事。

我觉得它的设定与游戏想要讲述的故事是契合的，我甚至觉得我可以像游戏明显希望我做的那样，自己解开它的谜团，但我还在努力理解游戏的其他许多机制，现在我感觉自己真的被打乱了节奏。我试着悄悄调查它，也试着把它打退，结果被打得很惨，因为战斗是一场苦战。而且，像这样的游戏，如果能避免的话，我根本不想进行战斗，所以对于零星的遭遇海盗来说，这种苦战感觉还不错，但这次不是。

其他玩家制作了可以停用[剧透]肉[/剧透]内容的模组（这让人感觉挺解气的），但目前它们只能阻止它生成，无法从我如今已经投入了近 20 小时的存档中移除它。

我推荐这款游戏。即使作为抢先体验产品，打捞部分也感觉接近功能完整，我很享受这一点。我只是希望我能在深入这款带有另一层内容的游戏之前，有时间真正在核心太空打捞体验中取得成功。我明白其他玩家会比我目前享受得多，我只是觉得它抽走了我游戏体验中的空气。

observations.description: 战斗是苦差事，被击败
observations.evidence: I tried to investigate it quietly and I've tried fighting it off and was thrashed because combat is a slog
observations.evidence_zh: 我试过悄悄调查它，也试过把它打退，结果被打得很惨，因为战斗实在是一场苦战

items.text:
Picked it back up and started a new save, only to be reminded of the reason I abandoned the last one:
The meat, the damned meat.

I docked with a single derelict that contained it, lamented triggering the event knowingly, and took what I could before leaving. It was too late, though, as the meat had spread through space into my ship's cell. It was in the far corner where I couldn't see it, and by the time I did it was far too late. Half of my hull had become a giant meatball, and after docking at a station for my usual offloading and refueling it struck. Spread right into K-LEG and wouldn't stop.

By the end of it, not only had I noticed my ship's infestation far too late, I was also too late to stop it from infesting the only station I could access at that point in time; it doesn't help that you'll get arrested for fighting the meat in front of people, since this game doesn't register human interaction with much nuance. All of this because the meat had technically entered my ship's cell, meaning it was tainted even if it hadn't touched my ship yet.
It was spreading faster than my single character could possibly claw through it with his crowbar and busted laser welder, so I saw the only fitting end to be a direct impact with Ganymed at 2100 m/s. At least I got a cinematic ending out of this slog.

The takeaway here is that the game just ain't ready. I love Ostranauts to death and I love what Blue Bottle Games are doing with it, but the meat is one of several features that just feels ham-fisted in for the sake of the setting with little regard for how it actually affects gameplay in the long run; it's avoidable, but only if you're lucky enough to notice when it starts or knowledgeable enough to avoid triggering it entirely, both of which are things new players won't be able to do.
It's a shame.
items.text_zh:
我重新捡起它，开了一个新存档，结果又被提醒了我放弃上一个存档的原因：
肉，该死的肉。

我停靠在一艘含有它的废弃飞船上，明知会触发事件还是 lamented 地触发了，然后能拿什么就拿什么，离开了。但已经太晚了，因为肉已经穿过太空蔓延到了我飞船的舱室里。它就在我看不到的远角，等我看到时已经太晚了。我的一半船体已经变成了一个巨大的肉球，而在停靠到一个空间站进行我惯常的卸货和加油后，它发作了。直接蔓延进了K-LEG，停不下来。

到最后，我不仅太晚才注意到飞船的感染，也太晚才阻止它感染我当时唯一能进入的空间站；更糟的是，在人们面前与肉搏斗会被逮捕，因为这款游戏对人类互动的处理缺乏细微差别。所有这一切都是因为肉在技术上已经进入了我的飞船舱室，意味着即使它还没碰到我的飞船，飞船也已经被污染了。
它蔓延的速度比我单个角色用撬棍和坏掉的激光焊枪能劈开的速度快得多，所以我看到了唯一合适的结局：以2100米/秒的速度直接撞向Ganymed。至少我从这场苦差事中得到了一个电影般的结局。

这里的结论是，这款游戏还没准备好。我热爱Ostranauts至极，也热爱Blue Bottle Games对它所做的，但肉是几个感觉像是为了设定而强行塞入的功能之一，几乎不考虑它长期对玩法的影响；它是可以避免的，但只有你足够幸运在它开始时注意到，或者足够了解以完全避免触发它，而这两点新玩家都做不到。
真遗憾。

observations.description: 肉感染机制设计粗糙，传播过快且难以应对
observations.evidence: the meat is one of several features that just feels ham-fisted in for the sake of the setting with little regard for how it actually affects gameplay in the long run
observations.evidence_zh: 肉块只是几个为了设定而硬塞进来的功能之一，几乎不考虑它在长期内实际如何影响玩法。

items.text:
A good game built on solid mechanic ideas, but ultimately (as of writing) in serious need of both more features and adjustments to already existing ones. Some elements don't make sense (chargen vs gigs + natural leveling) or are overpowered (gigs in general).

If you're a fan of NEO Scavenger and want to support the development, go for it. Otherwise, this is one of those Early Access games where it desperately needs more time in the oven before you should consider putting money down on it.
items.text_zh:
一款建立在扎实机制创意之上的好游戏，但最终（截至撰写时）既急需更多功能，也需要对现有功能进行调整。有些元素说不通（角色创建与任务+自然升级的对比），或者过于强大（任务系统整体而言）。

如果你是NEO Scavenger的粉丝并且想支持开发，那就去吧。否则，这就是那种抢先体验游戏，在你考虑掏钱之前，它迫切需要更多时间打磨。

Update: I've played a bit more since my initial review and while I think I overreacted previously, the gameplay loop quickly gets stale.

This game is barely functional and has no interest in telling you how its mechanics work or giving you a reason to want to learn how they work. Constant beeping from 20 different consoles that means nothing also really gets on my nerves after awhile.

更新：自初次评测以来我又玩了一些，虽然我觉得之前反应过度了，但玩法循环很快就变得乏味。

这款游戏勉强能运行，而且完全不想告诉你它的机制如何运作，也不给你一个想去了解它们如何运作的理由。来自20个不同控制台的持续哔哔声毫无意义，过一阵子也真的让我很烦躁。

items.text: So... The game sucks you in. But man it's grindy. To get anywhere You will have to spend so many hours... Even the sleep takes forever. It's like if You had taken Your life 1 to 1 and added a bunch of interface to traverse. Even Starfield is much less grindy than this. I can't recommend this game to anyone that has a tiniest bit of a respect for his time.

items.text:
Wow!  This game has fantastic potential.  It hits something I've been wanting for a long time.  A gritty space sim where you crawl your way out of oppression through any means necessary... and it can surely be a grind... but as you find / build a more sustainable, more comfortable existence... it feels tangible and rewarding.  
 
Want to be a derelict ship salvager… check, want to work in refurbishing, buying damaged goods and selling higher, check… want to run cargo between stations working the economy... check.  Want to do gig work investigating murders and transporting special cargo… check.  Want to attack civilians and take of their hard earned efforts, check.  Want nuanced, impactful NPC interactions… check… Want to hire a crew to help you with any of the above, check.  And I should add… that all this simply feels like the groundwork.  It’s easy to see that there will be so much more.  However, in its current EA state… its still quite rough.  

Basically, there are a lot of jank and pathing issues.  For example, one of my character employees decided he needed to relieve himself.  Inside the ship... inside the safety of the pressurized, oxygenated cabin where he could safely remove his space suit and take care of that... instead, as he tries, I get an error message saying he can't while "airtight."  I think... ok, not bad... I can see why that might be important in some situations.  EXCEPT, then he walks out onto a derelict... unpressurized, bathroom... exposed to the vacuum of space... and then THROUGH his airtight suit... uses the bathroom.  Funny.  Essentially, the AI and game seems to lag / bog down or get more easily confused as your ship gets bigger and / or the tasks assigned become more complicated.  


Graphically the game is cute.  It captures a lot of detail about a wide range of parts… all of which can be interacted with in some way.  Some of the parts themselves could use some more detail… ie… do different hull types have different hp values, etc, but the look of the game is great.   

UI / Combat – This took some adjusting, but you start to appreciate the choices available… all things are done through narrative choices.  You choose your actions step by step in dialogue, in combat, and possibly other situations.   Also, I highly undervalued, at first, how relatable and engaging it was to see your character face and emotions (sometimes a bit over the top, but better than the standard nothing) 

Some suggestions for the Devs – More… more stuff… more reasons… better progression.  Suits could have Modular additions that enhance different things like movement or radiation resistance.  Different types of engines with different focuses and values.   Cooking would fit well in some fashion… as well as hydroponics that you can grow on your ship.  (Not looking for a farm sim, but some basics could be very congruent.) 

The learning curve is rather steep… and the found manuals in the game are DENSE… if you want to understand the Environmental settings for your ship, set up a better power supply, or learn about any number of other systems you must read… actual… in game… manuals.  No tutorials on this stuff yet as far as I know.  I understand the point and the added immersion, but a compromise might be good here.  The manuals might have linked tables of contents that flip you to the correct information / paragraph.  

Better interactions with your ship crew would be useful.   From the navigation console, for example, being able to issue ship wide instructions like … “prepare for departure” or “Prepare to be boarded.”

Piracy and Combat – This could do with another way to board another ship… or infiltrate a station.  Drop pods that burst through wall of a ship after some challenge similar to docking.  Also, a single pirate would likely be a bit more cautious than boldly walking onto a docked vessel with a crew of four gun wielding opponents.  This surely needs some balancing.  Being able to loot actually currency in ships seems like it would be useful as well.  Likewise, looking forward to seeing what the game does with the promised ship to ship.  

All in all, I do recommend this game based upon its potential.  Understand, though, that this is with the caveat that it is still noticeably early access and has many unfinished and unpolished systems.  If you want to support the devs in its current state, buy it now and give feedback… otherwise check back in some months as it is getting regular updates.  

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As my hours might show, I've been playing this game quite a lot again.  First of all!   Much less jank.  A lot of the issues I mentioned before have been resolved or folded into in a way that feels authentic.  The game is making steady progress.   

What I'd like to see now is more in depth characters.  The dialogue options have a certain charm, but I think that they could be more robust or character relevant.  As it stands they feel a bit generic.... not to say that 100% unique is expected all the time, but more differentiation here would help distinguish NPCs.  On a similar note, more developed factions, standings with factions, missions, intrigue, alliances, and shades of gray... all could be fleshed out more.  Much in the way NPCs can be more readily Identifiable  and differentiable.   

It could also be nice to have different starts - i.e maybe instead of starting in debt to the bank paying off a ship that was your only way forward, maybe you start indebted to the crime / pirate syndicates around Venus or another faction in one way or another.   Or maybe you're not in debt at all... maybe the story derives even more from the choices you choose crafting your character.  

Either way... Mechanically speaking.  The grind to get a fusion reactor working on your ship is very long... especially if you don't understand it.  The manuals explain it decently, but it could be a bit better.  A subtle thing that might help with this could be that players can observe functioning ships with fully operational fusion systems earlier on, but have no access... or any attempt to steal a currently active ship would have serious consequences.  

Lastly, the crime system ( as well as the means and reasons to commit crime)  and law enforcement could be enhanced a bit.   I know the punishments increase in some other places, but its easy to exploit kleg a bit.   In addition, on the other hand, it would be fun if you could actually take over places from factions, by killing enough, but exploits like shoving them back by placing doors would have to be fixed first.  Also, it could also be that a place you control, if you've taken something over, could have attacks from factions.  

Anyway, 

Great Progress and can't wait to see more.
items.text_zh:
哇！这款游戏潜力巨大。它触及了我长久以来一直想要的东西。一个硬核的太空模拟游戏，你通过任何必要的手段从压迫中挣扎出来……这肯定可能很肝……但当你找到/建立起一种更可持续、更舒适的生活时……它感觉是实实在在的、有回报的。

想当一名废弃飞船打捞者……可以；想从事翻新工作，买受损货物再高价卖出……可以；想在空间站之间跑货运、玩转经济……可以。想接零工调查谋杀案、运送特殊货物……可以。想攻击平民、夺走他们辛苦赚来的成果……可以。想要细腻、有影响力的NPC互动……可以……想雇佣一支船员来帮你完成上述任何事……可以。我还应该补充……这一切感觉只是基础。很容易看出还会有更多内容。然而，在目前的EA状态下……它仍然相当粗糙。

基本上，有很多毛病和寻路问题。例如，我的一个角色员工决定他需要解手。在飞船里……在加压、供氧的舱室安全环境中，他可以安全地脱下太空服来处理这件事……结果，当他尝试时，我收到一条错误信息，说他在“气密”状态下不能这么做。我想……好吧，不错……我能理解为什么在某些情况下这很重要。但是，然后他走到一艘废弃飞船上……未加压的、厕所……暴露在太空真空中……然后透过他的气密服……上了厕所。好笑。本质上，随着你的飞船变大和/或分配的任务变得更复杂，AI和游戏似乎会卡顿/变慢或更容易混乱。


从画面来看，游戏很可爱。它捕捉了各种部件的许多细节……所有这些部件都能以某种方式互动。有些部件本身可以再多些细节……比如……不同船体类型是否有不同的生命值等等，但游戏的外观很棒。

UI/战斗——这需要一些适应，但你会开始欣赏可用的选择……所有事情都通过叙事选择来完成。你在对话、战斗以及可能其他情况中一步步选择你的行动。另外，我一开始严重低估了看到你的角色面部和情绪（有时有点夸张，但总比标准的什么都没有好）是多么有共鸣和吸引人。

给开发者的一些建议——更多……更多东西……更多理由……更好的进程。太空服可以有模块化附加装置，增强不同方面，比如移动或抗辐射能力。不同类型的引擎有不同的侧重点和数值。烹饪在某种程度上会很合适……还有可以在飞船上种植的水培。（不是想要农场模拟，但一些基础内容会非常契合。）

学习曲线相当陡峭……而且游戏中找到的手册非常密集……如果你想了解飞船的环境设置、建立更好的电源，或学习任何其他系统，你必须阅读……真正的……游戏内……手册。据我所知，目前还没有关于这些东西的教程。我理解其用意和增加的沉浸感，但折中方案可能不错。手册可以有链接目录，让你翻到正确的信息/段落。

与飞船船员更好的互动会很有用。例如，从导航控制台，能够发布全船指令，比如……“准备出发”或“准备接舷”。

海盗行为和战斗——这可以再有另一种登上另一艘船的方式……或潜入空间站。在类似对接的某种挑战后，用投放舱冲破飞船墙壁。另外，一个海盗很可能比大胆走上停靠的船只、面对四名持枪对手的船员要谨慎一些。这肯定需要一些平衡。能够掠夺飞船上的实际货币似乎也会很有用。同样，期待看到游戏在承诺的船对船方面会有什么表现。

总而言之，基于其潜力，我确实推荐这款游戏。但请理解，这是有前提的，即它仍明显处于抢先体验阶段，有许多未完成和未打磨的系统。如果你想在目前状态下支持开发者，现在就买并给出反馈……否则过几个月再回来看看，因为它正在定期更新。

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

从我的游戏时长可以看出，我又玩了很多这款游戏。首先！毛病少多了。我之前提到的很多问题已经解决，或以感觉真实的方式融入了。游戏正在稳步进展。

我现在想看到的是更有深度的角色。对话选项有一定的魅力，但我认为它们可以更丰富或更与角色相关。就目前而言，它们感觉有点通用……不是说一直期望100%独特，但这里更多的差异化会有助于区分NPC。类似地，更发达的派系、与派系的关系、任务、阴谋、联盟和灰色地带……都可以进一步充实。就像NPC可以更容易被识别和区分一样。

有不同的开局也会不错——比如，也许不是一开始欠银行债务、要还清一艘你唯一前进之路的飞船，也许你一开始以某种方式欠金星周围的犯罪/海盗集团或另一个派系的债。或者也许你根本不欠债……也许故事更多地源自你塑造角色时所做的选择。

不管怎样……从机制上说。让飞船上的聚变反应堆运转起来的肝度非常长……尤其是如果你不理解它的话。手册解释得还算不错，但可以更好一点。一个可能有助于此的微妙之处是，玩家可以在早期观察到拥有完全运作聚变系统的飞船，但无法进入……或者任何试图偷窃一艘当前活跃飞船的行为都会有严重后果。

最后，犯罪系统（以及犯罪的手段和理由）和执法可以稍微增强。我知道在其他一些地方惩罚会增加，但很容易稍微利用kleg。此外，另一方面，如果你能通过杀足够多的人真正从派系手中接管地方，那会很有趣，但像通过放置门把他们推回去这样的漏洞必须先修复。另外，也可能是你控制的地方，如果你接管了什么，可能会遭到派系的攻击。

总之，

进步很大，迫不及待想看到更多。
发布全舰指令，比如……“准备出发”或“准备接舷。”

海盗行为与战斗——这方面可以再增加一种登上另一艘船……或潜入空间站的方式。投放舱在经历某种类似对接的挑战后冲破船体墙壁。另外，单个海盗很可能会比大胆地走进一艘停靠着的、船上有四名持枪对手的飞船更谨慎一些。这肯定需要一些平衡。能够掠夺飞船上的实际货币似乎也会很有用。同样，期待看到游戏如何处理承诺的船对船战斗。

总而言之，基于其潜力，我确实推荐这款游戏。但请理解，这是附带一个前提的，即它仍明显处于抢先体验阶段，有许多未完成和未打磨的系统。如果你想在其当前状态下支持开发者，现在就买并给出反馈……否则过几个月再回来看看，因为它正在定期更新。

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

正如我的游戏时长可能显示的那样，我又玩了这款游戏相当多的时间。首先！卡顿少多了。我之前提到的很多问题已经解决，或以某种感觉真实的方式融入了游戏。游戏正在稳步推进。

我现在希望看到的是更有深度的角色。对话选项有一种特定的魅力，但我认为它们可以更丰富，或与角色更相关。就目前而言，它们感觉有点泛泛……不是说一直期待100%独一无二，但这里更多的差异化会有助于区分NPC。类似地，更发达的派系、与派系的关系、任务、阴谋、联盟和灰色地带……都可以进一步充实。就像NPC可以更容易被识别和区分那样。

有不同的开局也会不错——比如，也许不是一开始就欠银行债、要偿还一艘你唯一前进之路的飞船，也许你一开始以某种方式欠金星周围的犯罪/海盗辛迪加或另一个派系的债。或者也许你根本不欠债……也许故事更多地源自你塑造角色时所做的选择。

不管怎样……从机制上说。让你的飞船上的聚变反应堆运转起来的刷取过程非常漫长……尤其是在你不理解它的时候。手册解释得还算不错，但本可以更好一点。一个可能有助于此的细微之处是，玩家可以更早观察到拥有完全可用聚变系统的正常运转飞船，但无法进入……或者任何试图偷窃一艘当前活跃飞船的行为都会有严重后果。

最后，犯罪系统（以及犯罪的手段和理由）和执法可以稍微增强一些。我知道在其他一些地方惩罚会增加，但很容易稍微利用kleg。此外，另一方面，如果你能通过杀足够多的人真正从派系手中接管地点，那会很有趣，但像通过放置门把它们推回去这样的漏洞必须先修复。另外，也可能是，如果你接管了某个地方，你所控制的地点可能会遭到派系攻击。

总之，

进步很大，迫不及待想看到更多。

items.text:
Love the game but be aware than only the ship building (control panel) part work. The space-sim social part of the game is broken and doesn't really work. Also, the traits at the character creation doesn't seem randomized.

The game also lack of self-knowledge. I mean by that than you need to go deep into an obscure discord to find the information you need about basic and obvious stuff and you are not even sure to find it. The community is great to help you but for this type of game, you should expect to be able to go on your own without asking. 

You should also know than for a ship builder, there is a lack of component parts to choose. There is maybe two different reactor to build and a bunch of rooms who have their own identity, for the rest, they recycle items use in other rooms. 

Apart from the starting location, there is not much to do. All the scrapyard are there, the second one is at Venus. The rest of the game is just about traveling at 3G to do trading.

There is station here and there, everywhere in the solar system, but since the social interaction is still a work in process, don't expect to find any point of interest to do there. No quest, no story. 

Even after 100 hours, i prefer to warn the newcomers. The game is dev since 2020 and is still in early state. I prefer saying the truth than lying. 

Even if i like the game, i don't see why i would progress further since the game is really repetitive and consist mostly into uninstalling always the same 10 components who have a sort of value at the market. (Yeah, market doesn't evolve, it's always the same parts who have some value, the rest is just scraps you left behind).

Anyway, 4 years in dev and so little achieve, i can't put a good review even if i enjoyed my time playing. There is other game who have smaller crew and who did better than this.

See this as a lifetime project from a guy who left the AAA industry to start a business on his own to pay the bill. There is thousand of project like that on steam sadly. At the end, the player will, again, have to wait x years to get a finish product.
items.text_zh:
喜欢这个游戏，但要注意只有飞船建造（控制面板）部分能正常工作。游戏的太空模拟社交部分坏掉了，实际上并不能正常运作。另外，角色创建时的特质似乎也不是随机化的。

游戏还缺乏自知之明。我的意思是，你需要深入一个晦涩的Discord才能找到关于基本和显而易见的东西所需的信息，而且你甚至不确定能否找到。社区很乐于帮助你，但对于这种类型的游戏，你应该期望能够自己独立进行而无需询问。

你还应该知道，对于一个飞船建造者来说，可供选择的组件部件很缺乏。可能只有两种不同的反应堆可以建造，还有一堆各自有自己身份的房间，至于其余的，他们回收利用其他房间里使用的物品。

除了起始地点之外，没有太多可做的事情。所有的废料场都在那里，第二个在金星。游戏的其余部分就只是在3G下旅行来做贸易。

太阳系各处到处都有空间站，但由于社交互动仍在开发中，不要指望在那里能找到任何值得关注的事情可做。没有任务，没有故事。

即使在100小时之后，我还是更愿意警告新来者。这个游戏从2020年开始开发，仍处于早期阶段。我宁愿说真话也不愿撒谎。

即使我喜欢这个游戏，我也看不出我为什么要继续推进，因为游戏真的很重复，主要就是不断卸载那同样的10个在市场上有点价值的组件。（是的，市场不会演变，总是同样的部件有价值，其余的就只是你丢下的废料）。

总之，开发了4年却成就如此之少，即使我享受了玩游戏的时光，我也无法给出好评。还有其他团队规模更小的游戏做得比这个更好。

把这看作是一个离开AAA行业、自己创业来付账单的人的一生项目。遗憾的是，Steam上有成千上万个这样的项目。最终，玩家将再次不得不等待X年才能得到一个完成的产品。

observations.description: 太空模拟社交部分损坏无法运作
observations.evidence: The space-sim social part of the game is broken and doesn't really work
observations.evidence_zh: 游戏的太空模拟社交部分坏掉了，而且并不真正起作用

items.text:
nice game
has a good scifi vibe. 
good sound, beside the darker tracks.
Like the ship building and systems.

little complicato.
takes time and ytube to understand.
needs improvement in regard to graphics and how to interact (for ex. layers for building - would like to see the floors only to fix airleaks due to miss clicking;).
Would love to see a real spaceflight from outside of the ship.

what is really not good; 
it has a very hard start due to the character creation, normally either you end up with a young character with near to no skills and very bad traits OR you end up with an old better character (40-50) which then just gets problems like slow/artritis/not healthy/etc. Both lead to a lenghty gameplay at the start.
This makes to me no sense, since i like to enjoy a nice game play..with later arising problems.
Devs should think about a certain difficulty curve later in the game. At start i think you need a good performing character to build your dream ship, what is my goal.

I would wish from the devs to implement an easy mode option in the main menu at start or during character creation, where then a decent character can be created to start with (+10-20k money at least).

If found a solution via the F3 menu to completely pimp and edit my character & money based on the devs own redit post. But this should not be the way to go. Since i do like a good start, just make it possible in the game as an option.

Thanks anyways for the great game.

items.text_zh:
不错的游戏
有很好的科幻氛围。
音效不错，除了那些更阴暗的曲目。
喜欢飞船建造和系统。

有点复杂。
需要花时间和上YouTube才能理解。
在画面和交互方式上需要改进（例如，建造时的图层——希望能只看到楼层，以便修复因误点造成的漏气；）。
很想看到从飞船外部进行的真实太空飞行。

真正不好的地方；
由于角色创建，开局非常艰难，通常你要么得到一个几乎没有技能且特质非常糟糕的年轻角色，要么得到一个年纪较大、更好的角色（40-50岁），但随后就会出现迟钝/关节炎/不健康等问题。两者都会导致开局阶段游戏时间漫长。
这对我来说毫无意义，因为我喜欢享受良好的游戏体验……问题应该在后期才出现。
开发者应该考虑在游戏后期设置一定的难度曲线。开局时我认为你需要一个表现良好的角色来建造你梦想中的飞船，而这是我的目标。

我希望开发者能在开局的主菜单中或角色创建期间加入一个简单模式选项，这样就可以创建一个像样的角色来开局（至少+10-20k金钱）。

我通过F3菜单找到了一个解决方案，可以根据开发者自己的Reddit帖子完全强化和编辑我的角色与金钱。但这不应该是可行之道。因为我确实喜欢一个好的开局，就把它作为游戏中的一个选项实现吧。

无论如何，感谢这款很棒的游戏。

附言：请改进画面……我的眼睛疼，而且看不清女孩和飞船漂亮的轮廓:)

observations.description: 角色创建导致开局困难，年轻角色技能差，年老角色有健康问题
observations.evidence: it has a very hard start due to the character creation, normally either you end up with a young character with near to no skills and very bad traits OR you end up with an old better character (40-50) which then just gets problems like slow/artritis/not healthy/etc.
observations.evidence_zh: 由于角色创建，开局非常艰难，通常你要么最终得到一个几乎没有技能、特质非常糟糕的年轻角色，要么得到一个更优秀但年长的角色（40-50岁），然后就会遇到诸如迟缓/关节炎/不健康之类的问题。

OK, so updating review but keeping old text below for accuracy. 

It's had some work, and I'm getting no crashes or 'jank' beyond needing to save and reload after long 6 hours play sessions and odd crew behaviour emerging. 

It's got me. It's bitten me good and I'm trapped. I got my first reactor set up from salvaged parts, of a derelict I found and restored. I got jumped twice and had to kill someone by stripping them of a space suit in vacuum and just...waiting. Then I saved someone on a derelict and I hired them on as crew. 

It's got its quirks, and it's not for everyone - but that's a good thing. If your looking at it and thinking 'yeah, I like the style, the vibe, the hardcore nature' I'd say do it. Or at least wishlist it. 

There are still some things that I think need polish or working on, but yeah. I'm hooked. ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥. I literally go to bed thinking of ship layouts.

Old review below

Great concept but it needs alot of work. 

Had to restart 3 times due to hardlocking or crashing Twice my ship just exploded upon undocking, the game couldnt do all the simulation but trash suddenly appeared everywhere and the game froze. I had touched the flight controls but mostly out habit. If the game cant handle that, dont let the player do it. 

Final crash was when i got pulled over by police, negotiated a warning, and then when I went back to my ship - we undocked automatically I think while i was stilly walking over. Character vanished, camera just started spinning, log showed I was taking damage, died. 

When it does work its a fun game, cool concept, art style is good but its really hard to tell what your looking at most of the time. Which is a bummer. Got legit locked in my room early game because I couldnt 'see' the rack it was pointing me at. 

Finally, when I did scrap two ships, i got back, sold my haul, and discovered I'd not scrapped the 'right stuff' because the $300 i made did not cover the $500 dollar docking fee. I'd have taken more scrap, but the ship I got was tiny. So I couldn't fit anything. The ship in the character before that, had chunks missing, didnt hold pressure, all the alarms going off. So that was also a restart.

好吧，所以更新评测，但为了准确起见保留下面的旧文本。

它经历了一些改动，除了在长时间6小时游戏后需要保存并重新加载，以及奇怪的船员行为出现之外，我没有遇到崩溃或“卡顿”。

它抓住我了。它狠狠地咬住了我，我被困住了。我从一艘找到并修复的废弃飞船的回收零件中建立了我的第一个反应堆。我被袭击了两次，不得不通过在真空中剥去某人的太空服然后……等待来杀死他。然后我在一艘废弃飞船上救了一个人，并雇佣他作为船员。

它有它的怪癖，并不适合所有人——但这是件好事。如果你看着它并想着“是的，我喜欢这种风格、氛围、硬核本质”，我会说去做吧。或者至少加入愿望单。

还有一些我认为需要打磨或改进的地方，但是的。我上瘾了。♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥。我 literally 上床睡觉时都在想飞船布局。

很棒的概念，但需要大量工作。

由于硬锁或崩溃不得不重启3次。两次我的飞船在脱离对接时直接爆炸，游戏无法完成所有模拟，但垃圾突然到处出现，游戏冻结了。我碰过飞行控制，但主要是出于习惯。如果游戏无法处理这个，就不要让玩家这么做。

最后一次崩溃是当我被警察拦下，协商了一个警告，然后当我回到我的飞船时——我想是在我还在走过去的时候我们自动脱离对接了。角色消失了，摄像机开始旋转，日志显示我受到了伤害，死了。

当它正常工作时，它是一个有趣的游戏，很酷的概念，艺术风格不错，但大多数时候真的很难分辨你在看什么。这很令人失望。游戏早期我合法地被锁在我的房间里，因为我无法“看到”它指向我的架子。

最后，当我确实拆解了两艘飞船，我回来了，卖掉了我的货物，发现我没有拆解“正确的东西”，因为我赚的300美元没有覆盖500美元的对接费。我本可以拿更多废料，但我得到的飞船很小。所以我什么都装不下。之前那个角色的飞船，有缺失的块，无法保持压力，所有警报都在响。所以那也是一次重启。

items.text:
Before you buy - do note that this game will be better in future, a lot is planned.
Recently a new open betatest patch has been released, .14 that would be, and it is a big leap to what has been in game before. They have added atmosphere to planets, gravity and its effects, including movement g-forces, and a few other things, as well as made gui easier to read. 

I would say if you want to support developers and not afraid to wait a few years until game is finished - welcome.
And you can play it now, it does work, but it will only get better with time from what it is now.

Pros
+ Immersive
Quite a lot immersive elements, gui sometimes, worldbuilding really does it. Oxygen, heat, part decay and tools, there are a lot of elements there. Even each docking session is a minigame of sorts, which is close to how it is in real life, but in 2d movement and way greater speeds. It leaves space for fun, after all. THERE ARE GUIDES TO REACTOR, NAV CONSOLE AND STUFF THAT LOOK LIKE REAL MANUALS! I have almost never seen that in other games, it really adds to it.
+ Free to explore and roleplay
You can be anything you want and manage to be. Want to work under corp you were born into? Or you want to go outlaw and refuse to pay docking fees anymore? Or you want to reject society and just kill everyone you find your hands on? Heck, you can get your ship in a mortgage and just not pay it, though it will result large fines that you will be forced to pay once you dock to public station, unfortunately. You can become a sort of pirate, docking to other people ships, killing them and them scrapping their ships for parts, since no-one will ask where they come from, no witnesses.
Or you can become an interplanetry trader that multiplies money. Or you can roleplay as moron and go outside of airlock without a helmet on.
+ Quite a few mysteries
Unfortunately, cant write much here, its not fun if you dont figure this yourself, but first interaction with REDACTED will leave you REDACTED and that is REDACTED. Also, first time I saw REDACTED I have REDACTED, I kid you not. 
Purple suit is a lie purple suit is a lie purple suit is a lie purple suit is REDACTED
+ Quite some content
There is some content already present, enough for a ~40 hours if you really want to visit it all and know how to, but most of that time you will make money, though. Thankfully, most of it will happen as you collect money, in-between.
+ Ship building system
It is not too hard, not too easy. Just ideal in my opinion - you dont have to micromanage every wire and pipe, yet you cant just slap some gas cans on a box and call it a ship - you need more than that, especially if you want to fly on it longer than a day or two. You dont HAVE to seal the hull, but you will last as long as your suits oxygen/power. You dont need a reactor, but you will essentially run on accumulators, which means if you dont manage your power closely you will find yourself stranded on piece of scrap hundreds of kilometers off any station. Oh, and now that they added atmosphere, you can fly in there and its somewhat complex, you cant just strap some wings and propellers on your 200 tonned hauler and expect if to fly. 
+ Devs are cool people
This is more of a personal one, but you can talk to them on games discord channel, they often show up there and talk to people, they dont hide and interact frequently, which means if you really want to you can influence games development in a way, perhaps. After seeing a lot of those detached companies that just make profit and think of their customers as "big needy babies" this is some fresh air.
+ Price
It is somewhat cheap, it is certainly not expensive. Right now might be a bit too much, but you can think of it as a pre-order of sorts, thats why its early access, but in my country its costs as a large mcdonalds meal, unlike some other games that can reach costs of a new smartphone.

There are some cons, though, cant be without it
- Game is somewhat raw
Yes, there is some content already, but if you really look into it there isnt that much to do. Until recently there was only one planetoid and surrounding stations available, which really limited what you can and will do. 
- Bugs, bugs!
They are everywhere, such is the way. But you can report them though, there is an easy form you can do that in devs discord, but takes time to fix, and some of them can be really annoying, like 6 hours timeskip doesnt empty your sleep need, while sitting for 30 minutes with 16x time speed will. 
- Lack of multiplayer
This is unfortunate, as I really would like to play this game with my friends, but such is the nature of this game that this is simply not possible. Although, they might make a pvp mode just for that, maybe...
- Some features lacking
Yes, games bones and some meat are in place, but small features really make it annoying, like, there is no way to replenish small oxygen canisters, if you try to fill them up with normal pumps they just blow up, because they pump more pressure in one tick than that poor alluminum bottle can take. There is a crew system, but there are barely any uses for them. Sure, you can just order them to completly dissasemble some ship and haul it all home, or use second crew member as your character while main one sleeps, but you have to pay them and there is a death fee you pay if they go outside of airlock without a helmet, and for some reason they do that more often than I would want... Yes, there is a way to buy citizenship and get an apartment of your own, but you can only buy same one, they didnt add more yet. Again, this is to be added in future, they have confirmed that, this is more of a "buy now" con.
- lack of variety in some things.
There are only 3 food brands, cheap af preserfved food with like 10 variations of flavout and two street vendors, who offer 3 dishes each. Few tools - screwdriver, hacksaw, their better versions angle grinder and power drill, small welder, soldering tool and their better alternative, laser tool. And crowbar. Could really use a few more brands/variations of tools, so that there are diffrent brands of power drill for example, even if its just 2 or 3. Not that critical compared to some other things, like, game has illegal station with "drug seller" but no drugs except for 4 types of pills (medical), 3 types of injections (medical) and basically thats it.
items.text_zh:
在你购买之前——请注意，这款游戏在未来会变得更好，有很多计划。
最近发布了一个新的公开测试补丁，应该是.14版本，与之前游戏中的内容相比是一个巨大的飞跃。他们为行星添加了大气层、重力及其效果，包括移动时的G力，以及其他一些东西，还让GUI更易于阅读。

我想说，如果你想支持开发者并且不怕等上几年直到游戏完成——欢迎。
而且你现在就可以玩，它确实能运行，但随着时间的推移，它只会比现在更好。

优点
+ 沉浸感
有相当多的沉浸元素，有时是GUI，世界构建真的做到了。氧气、热量、部件老化和工具，那里有很多元素。甚至每次对接都算是一种小游戏，这接近现实生活中的情况，但采用2D移动和更快的速度。毕竟，这为乐趣留下了空间。有关于反应堆、导航控制台之类的东西的指南，看起来像真正的手册！我几乎从未在其他游戏中见过这种，它真的增加了沉浸感。
+ 自由探索和角色扮演
你可以成为任何你想成为并能做到的人。想在你出生的公司下工作？或者你想成为不法之徒，拒绝再支付对接费？或者你想拒绝社会，杀掉你遇到的每一个人？哎呀，你可以用抵押贷款买船然后就不还，不过不幸的是，这会导致巨额罚款，一旦你停靠到公共空间站就不得不支付。你可以成为某种海盗，停靠到别人的船上，杀死他们，然后拆解他们的船获取零件，因为没人会问这些零件从哪来，没有目击者。
或者你可以成为星际商人，让钱翻倍。或者你可以扮演白痴，不戴头盔就走出气闸。
+ 相当多的谜团
不幸的是，这里不能写太多，如果你不自己弄清楚就不好玩了，但与[已编辑]的第一次互动会让你[已编辑]，那就是[已编辑]。另外，我第一次看到[已编辑]时我[已编辑]，我没骗你。
紫色套装是谎言 紫色套装是谎言 紫色套装是谎言 紫色套装是[已编辑]
+ 相当多的内容
目前已经有一些内容，如果你真的想全部参观并且知道怎么做，足够玩大约40小时，不过大部分时间你都会在赚钱。幸运的是，大部分内容会在你赚钱的过程中顺便发生。
+ 飞船建造系统
不太难，也不太简单。在我看来刚刚好——你不必微观管理每一根电线和管道，但也不能随便把几个气罐贴在一个盒子上就称之为飞船——你需要的不止这些，特别是如果你想在它上面飞行超过一两天。你不必密封船体，但你的持续时间取决于你宇航服的氧气/电力。你不需要反应堆，但你基本上会靠蓄电池运行，这意味着如果你不密切管理电力，你会发现自己搁浅在离任何空间站数百公里外的一堆废铁上。哦，既然他们添加了大气层，你可以飞进去，而且这有点复杂，你不能只是给200吨的运输船绑上一些翅膀和螺旋桨就指望它能飞。
+ 开发者是好人
这更多是个人感受，但你可以在游戏的Discord频道上和他们交谈，他们经常出现在那里和人聊天，他们不隐藏并且频繁互动，这意味着如果你真的想，你或许能以某种方式影响游戏的发展。在看到很多那些冷漠无情、只想着赚钱、把顾客当成“嗷嗷待哺的大婴儿”的公司之后，这真是一股新鲜空气。
+ 价格
它算是有点便宜，肯定不贵。现在可能有点太贵了，但你可以把它看作某种预购，这就是为什么它是抢先体验，但在我所在的国家，它的价格相当于一顿大份麦当劳套餐，不像其他一些游戏能达到一部新智能手机的价格。

不过也有一些缺点，不可能没有
- 游戏还有些粗糙
是的，已经有一些内容了，但如果你真的深入看，其实没那么多可做的。直到最近，只有一个星体和周围的站点可用，这真的限制了你能够和将会做的事情。
- 漏洞，漏洞！
它们到处都是，就是这样。但你可以报告它们，在开发者的Discord里有一个简单的表格可以做到，但修复需要时间，而且其中一些真的很烦人，比如6小时的时间跳跃不会清空你的睡眠需求，而用16倍时间速度坐30分钟却会。
- 缺少多人游戏
这很不幸，因为我真的很想和朋友们一起玩这个游戏，但这款游戏的性质就是这样，这根本不可能。不过，他们也许可能会专门为此做一个PvP模式，也许……
- 缺少一些功能
是的，游戏的骨架和一些肉已经到位，但小功能真的让人烦，比如，没有办法补充小型氧气罐，如果你试图用普通泵给它们充气，它们就会爆炸，因为泵在一个tick内注入的压力超过了那个可怜的铝瓶所能承受的。有一个船员系统，但几乎没有多少用途。当然，你可以直接命令他们完全拆解某艘船并把所有东西运回家，或者在主角色睡觉时使用第二个船员作为你的角色，但你必须付钱给他们，而且如果他们不戴头盔走出气闸，你还要支付死亡费用，而不知为何他们这样做的频率比我想要的更高……是的，有办法购买公民身份并获得你自己的公寓，但你只能买同一个，他们还没有添加更多。再次，这是未来要添加的，他们已经确认了，这更多是一个“现在购买”的缺点。
- 某些东西缺乏多样性。
只有3个食品品牌，便宜得要命的保存食品，大约有10种口味变化，还有两个街头小贩，每个提供3道菜。工具很少——螺丝刀、钢锯、它们更好的版本角磨机和电钻、小型焊机、焊接工具及其更好的替代品激光工具。还有撬棍。真的可以多用几个品牌/工具变体，比如有不同品牌的电钻，哪怕只有2或3个。相比其他一些事情，这不算太关键，比如，游戏有一个非法空间站，里面有“毒品贩子”，但除了4种药片（医疗）、3种注射剂（医疗）之外基本上没有毒品，差不多就是这样。
那些只想着赚钱、把顾客当成“嗷嗷待哺的大婴儿”的冷漠公司，这真是一股清流。
+ 价格
它算是有点便宜，绝对不算贵。现在可能有点偏贵，但你可以把它当成某种预购，这就是为什么它处于抢先体验阶段，不过在我的国家，它的价格相当于一份大号麦当劳套餐，不像其他一些游戏能贵到一部新智能手机的价格。

不过也有一些缺点，不可能没有
- 游戏还有点粗糙
是的，已经有一些内容了，但如果你真的深入去看，其实没那么多可做的。直到最近，只有一个星体和周围的站点可用，这真的限制了你能够和将会做的事情。
- Bug，Bug！
它们无处不在，就是这样。不过你可以报告它们，在开发者的Discord里有一个简单的表格可以填，但修复需要时间，而且有些Bug真的很烦人，比如6小时的时间跳跃不会清空你的睡眠需求，而坐着用16倍时间速度过30分钟却会。
- 缺少多人模式
这很不幸，因为我真的很想和朋友们一起玩这个游戏，但这个游戏的性质就是这样，这根本不可能。不过，他们也许可能会专门为此做一个PvP模式，也许吧……
- 缺少一些功能
是的，游戏的骨架和一些血肉已经到位，但一些小功能真的很让人恼火，比如，没有办法补充小型氧气罐，如果你试图用普通泵给它们充气，它们就会爆炸，因为泵在一个tick内注入的压力超过了那个可怜铝瓶能承受的。有一个船员系统，但几乎没什么用处。当然，你可以直接命令他们完全拆解某艘船并把所有东西运回家，或者在主角色睡觉时用第二个船员作为你的角色，但你必须付钱给他们，而且如果他们不戴头盔走出气闸，你还要付死亡费用，而不知为何他们这么做的频率比我想要的更高……是的，有办法购买公民身份并获得你自己的公寓，但你只能买同一个，他们还没有添加更多。再次强调，这将在未来添加，他们已经确认了，这更像是一个“现在就买”的缺点。
- 某些东西缺乏多样性。
只有3个食品品牌，便宜得要命的保存食品大约有10种口味变化，还有两个街头小贩，每人提供3道菜。工具很少——螺丝刀、钢锯、它们更好的版本角磨机和电钻、小型焊机、焊接工具以及它们更好的替代品激光工具。还有撬棍。真的可以多用几个品牌/工具变体，比如电钻有不同的品牌，哪怕只有2到3个也好。相比其他一些事情，这不算太关键，比如，游戏里有一个非法站点，里面有“毒品贩子”，但除了4种药片（医疗）、3种注射剂（医疗）之外基本上就没有毒品了，差不多就这些。

observations.description: 船员系统几乎没有用途，且船员会无故走出气闸导致死亡罚款
observations.evidence: There is a crew system, but there are barely any uses for them. Sure, you can just order them to completly dissasemble some ship and haul it all home, or use second crew member as your character while main one sleeps, but you have to pay them and there is a death fee you pay if they go outside of airlock without a helmet, and for some reason they do that more often than I would want...
observations.evidence_zh: 有一个船员系统，但几乎没有什么用处。当然，你可以直接命令他们完全拆解某艘飞船并把所有东西都运回家，或者在主角色睡觉时用第二名船员作为你的角色，但你必须付钱给他们，而且如果他们不戴头盔就走出气闸舱，你还要支付一笔死亡费用，而不知为何他们这么做的频率比我想要的要多……

items.text:
I wish there was a middle-ground review option beyond yes/no. This game has a really interesting premise, unfortunately marred by some very frustrating design decisions.

TLDR: Pretty frustrating to play right now, but a ton of great worldbuilding and a great art style. With some UX improvements, this could become a phenomenal game.

The fully diegetic interfaces are pretty opaque in terms of communicating gameplay functions. Tooltips are nowhere to be found. The interfaces are clearly crafted with a lot of care for the game's universe, but from a game design perspective, it falls short of creating a cohesive experience. Often it feels detached from the core gameplay of exploring and salvaging, like you've got to "deal with" using these opaque interfaces to get to the parts of the game that are actually fun.

Inventory and item management are pretty rough IMO. Nothing has tooltips, and what your character has equipped is handled with a single paper doll, with very little feedback about how things can be equipped or managed. This is solveable, but in it's current state, the UX left a lot to be desired.

Building & crafting also confused me. From the start, you have a HUGE catalog of things you can build. But why is everything unlocked from the start? You're telling me my 20 year old asthmatic ship salvager also *happens* to know how to build 12 different kinds of bulkhead storage bin? Furthermore, the crafting loop is pretty opaque too. Blueprints can be placed, but there was no clear way to actually craft things from what I could tell.

The core point of my review is that *more feedback to the user is essential.* Let the **consequences** of gameplay remain hardcore AF. Just give the user more information about what actions can be taken, and maybe rework the crafting loop to be more incrementally unlocked and guided.
items.text_zh:
我希望除了“是/否”之外，还能有一个折中的评测选项。这款游戏有一个非常有趣的前提设定，可惜被一些极其令人沮丧的设计决策给毁了。

长话短说：目前玩起来相当令人沮丧，但世界观构建非常出色，美术风格也很棒。如果能改进一些用户体验，这可能会成为一款现象级的游戏。

完全叙事内化的界面在传达玩法功能方面相当晦涩。提示框根本找不到。这些界面显然是为了游戏宇宙而精心打造的，但从游戏设计的角度来看，它未能营造出连贯统一的体验。很多时候，它感觉与探索和打捞的核心玩法脱节，就好像你不得不“忍受”使用这些晦涩的界面，才能到达游戏中真正有趣的部分。

在我看来，物品栏和物品管理相当粗糙。什么都没有提示框，你的角色装备了什么只靠一个纸娃娃来呈现，关于如何装备或管理物品的反馈极少。这是可以解决的，但在目前的状态下，用户体验还有很多不足之处。

建造和制作也让我很困惑。从一开始，你就有一个巨大的可建造物品目录。但为什么所有东西从一开始就解锁了？你是说，我这个20岁患有哮喘的飞船打捞员，还*恰好*知道怎么建造12种不同的舱壁储物箱？此外，制作循环也相当晦涩。蓝图可以放置，但据我所知，并没有明确的方法真正用它们来制作东西。

我评测的核心观点是，*给用户更多反馈至关重要。* 让玩法的**后果**保持硬核到爆。只要给用户更多关于可以采取哪些行动的信息，也许再重新设计一下制作循环，让它以更循序渐进的方式解锁并提供引导。

observations.description: 建造目录从一开始就全部解锁，缺乏渐进解锁
observations.evidence: why is everything unlocked from the start?
observations.evidence_zh: 为什么所有东西从一开始就解锁了？

items.text:
Update: 8/10/24:  So I'll upgrade this to a watch for improvements. There has not been an update since march 7th, but after a great deal more time in the game I can see what they devs are going for. The early game is not in fact as difficult as it seems but there is a distinct lack of communication of how systems work. Once you figure out the correct way to acquire and sell salvage, and how to atmospheric systems work much of the insta death and soft locking gets addressed. Again this is not well explained by the game, which would hopefully be addressed by the devs in future updates. 

Other systems that are poorly explained are the human interaction systems. You are given a set of very vague interactions you can perform such as laugh, touch, make a philosophical observation, reiterate urgency. However there's no context to any of this. You can just start a conversation by reiterating urgency. No idea what that does. The responses are equally as cryptic. Sometimes they just say So... or they laugh. Or they get angry. But there does not appear to be any rational reason behind the responses. If any of this interaction is at all relevant to the game is beyond me. And frankly if you can't tell if a system even has a point to the game then its not a very good system.

Original Review:
Currently this is a tentative no. The game has potential but is mired with a number of problems. The UI is not always intuitive and the pallet choices often make determining things are being placed/rotated difficult. The character creation is, kludgey and essentially a time waster. Its intend is to result in discovering your character but if you make a handfull of characters you know the answers needed to make a custom character. It would be better to just let some one design their character rather than go through the un-necessary traveler rpg like creation process. 

I am struggling to determine if the early game is actually difficult or just poorly designed. Most choices you make will likely result in either soft locking your self or out right dying. Given the number of times you will restart the game as a result of this, the character creation process up to boarding your ship feels more like a time sink than game play.

The game suffers from a distinct lack of "show don't tell" There is a user manual, which promises more documentation to come. However I don't know many people who thought to themselves you know what I want to do? I want to read 40 pages of technical documentation in order to play my video game. Documentation that is not easily referenced if you are in the middle of a catastrophic decompression event.

The game is also mired in tedium. You will manually dock with everything. It will take 2-5 minutes every time. You will manually fly to everything. It will take 5-10 minutes every time. You will not do anything of interest while these things are taking place. This means that 30 minutes out of every hour of play (for a round trip) will be spent doing nothing. These actions are represented by nothing more than arrows and line drawings, which while giving it a novel retro feel, do nothing in terms of game play. 

One nit pick. Putting on a helmet covers the game screen with the some what broken outline of a helmet... which is mostly just annoying and adds no real value to a top down game.

Ultimately this feels like it was inspired by "space station 13" and "traveler" and yet falls very short of both in terms of both.
items.text_zh:
更新：2024年8月10日：所以我会把它升级为“观望”，因为有一些改进。自3月7日以来没有更新，但在游戏中投入更多时间后，我能看出开发者想要追求什么。早期游戏实际上并不像看起来那么困难，但系统如何运作的沟通明显缺乏。一旦你弄清楚获取和出售回收物的正确方式，以及大气系统如何运作，许多瞬间死亡和软锁问题就得到了解决。再次强调，游戏对此解释得不够好，希望开发者能在未来的更新中解决这个问题。

其他解释不清的系统包括人际互动系统。你会得到一组非常模糊的互动选项，比如笑、触摸、发表哲学观察、重申紧迫性。然而，这些都没有任何背景。你可以直接通过重申紧迫性来开始对话。不知道那有什么用。回应也同样隐晦。有时他们只是说“所以……”或者笑。或者生气。但回应背后似乎没有任何合理的理由。这些互动是否与游戏有任何相关性，我完全不知道。坦率地说，如果你无法判断一个系统对游戏是否有意义，那它就不是一个很好的系统。

原始评论：
目前这是一个暂定的“不”。游戏有潜力，但被许多问题困扰。UI并不总是直观的，调色板选择常常使确定物品放置/旋转方向变得困难。角色创建既笨拙又基本上是在浪费时间。其意图是让你发现自己的角色，但如果你创建了少数几个角色，你就知道创建自定义角色所需的答案。更好的做法是直接让某人设计他们的角色，而不是经历不必要的类似《旅行者》RPG的创建过程。

我很难判断早期游戏是真的困难还是只是设计糟糕。你做出的大多数选择很可能导致要么软锁自己，要么直接死亡。考虑到你会因此重启游戏多次，从角色创建到登船的过程感觉更像是时间消耗而非游戏玩法。

游戏明显缺乏“展示而非讲述”。有一本用户手册，承诺会有更多文档。然而，我不知道有多少人会想“你知道吗，我想做什么？我想读40页技术文档来玩我的电子游戏。”这些文档在你遭遇灾难性减压事件时并不容易查阅。

游戏还陷入繁琐之中。你将手动与一切对接。每次需要2-5分钟。你将手动飞往一切地点。每次需要5-10分钟。在这些事情发生时，你不会做任何有趣的事。这意味着每小时的游戏时间中（往返），有30分钟将无所事事。这些动作仅由箭头和线条图表示，虽然给人一种新颖的复古感，但在游戏玩法上毫无作用。

一个小挑剔。戴上头盔后，游戏屏幕会被一个有些破损的头盔轮廓覆盖……这主要只是令人烦恼，对俯视视角游戏没有真正价值。

最终，这感觉像是受到《太空站13》和《旅行者》的启发，但在两者方面都远远不及。

observations.description: 角色创建过程繁琐且浪费时间
observations.evidence: The character creation is, kludgey and essentially a time waster.
observations.evidence_zh: 角色创建既笨拙又基本上是在浪费时间。

items.text:
I've seen a lot of people talk about having a hard time seeing things in this game, but I honestly feel like that's a good part of Ostranauts intended challenge. Of course you would have a hard time seeing inside an powered derelict if you don't bring a light with you, otherwise there would be little reason to use lights and no reward for learning how to optimize the way you explore.

There is a learning curve for the UI and controls, but it's something you can easily memorize in under an hour if you reference the instructions provided ingame. 

Ostranauts still lacks variety in the mid-to-end gameplay loop. Much of the implied complexity regarding managing ships and your characters has yet to be implemented, so there really isn't much left to learn after you have salvaged a dozen or so ships. The ship building process leaves a lot to be desired. The current construction mechanic is clunky to the extent of being not worth the effort of attempting more than basic repairs or modifications to existing ships.

I understand that this game is technically still in Early Access, but I would like to see more frequent updates. As of this review, we haven't seen a major update since the end of last year. That's 5 months of nothing but hotfixes and minor updates. Whether or not this continues will have a strong effect on my and likely others opinions about the game and its future.
items.text_zh:
我看到很多人说在这款游戏里很难看清东西，但老实说，我觉得这正是《Ostranauts》预期挑战中很好的一部分。当然，如果你不带灯就进入一艘无动力的废弃飞船，你会很难看清里面，否则使用灯就没什么理由，学习如何优化探索方式也就没有回报了。

UI和控制有学习曲线，但如果你参考游戏内提供的说明，不到一小时就能轻松记住。

《Ostranauts》在中后期游戏循环中仍然缺乏多样性。关于管理飞船和角色的许多隐含复杂性尚未实现，所以在你打捞了十几艘船之后，真的没什么可学的了。飞船建造过程还有很多不足之处。当前的建造机制笨拙到不值得为现有飞船尝试超出基本维修或改装的程度。

我明白这款游戏技术上仍处于抢先体验阶段，但我希望看到更频繁的更新。截至本评论，自去年年底以来我们还没有看到重大更新。那是5个月只有热修复和小更新。这种情况是否继续，将对我以及很可能其他人对这款游戏及其未来的看法产生强烈影响。

observations.description: 飞船建造机制笨拙，不值得尝试超出基本修理或改装
observations.evidence: The current construction mechanic is clunky to the extent of being not worth the effort of attempting more than basic repairs or modifications to existing ships.
observations.evidence_zh: 当前的建造机制笨拙到不值得费力去尝试对现有飞船进行超出基本维修或改装的操作。

items.text:
Revising my review, the game is a lot better than it was at the start, but some the misgivings I had about the game remain. Adding ship combat and more mystery content in general finally makes this have some real tension! And all the extra filters make it a lot easier to find items and discern modules and such. 

On the other hand, the developers still wanted this to be a Zoomer appealing sims-like, so a lot of social life simulator nonsense like pronouns, romance, mental illness, and poop just had to be in this shipbuilder game, though it's mostly optional at least. Combat in general is still just slap fighting, 

Finally this title does not have a real endgoal, not even optionally, leaving the title in a less complete feeling state forever, This game is good on discount for a few hours play for sure, that's really about it unless you've never played sims or are hyper fixated on lots of space ship building games.
items.text_zh:
修改我的评测，这款游戏比刚开始时好多了，但我对这款游戏的一些顾虑依然存在。加入飞船战斗和更多神秘内容总体上终于让这款游戏有了一些真正的紧张感！而且所有额外的筛选器让查找物品和辨别模块之类的东西容易多了。

另一方面，开发者仍然希望这是一款吸引Z世代的类模拟人生游戏，所以很多社交生活模拟器的胡扯，比如代词、恋爱、精神疾病和便便，就是非得塞进这款飞船建造游戏里，不过至少大部分是可选的。战斗总体上仍然只是互扇耳光，

最后，这款作品没有真正的最终目标，连可选目标都没有，让这款作品永远处于一种不那么完整的状态。这款游戏打折时玩上几个小时肯定不错，真的也就仅此而已了，除非你从没玩过模拟人生，或者对大量太空飞船建造游戏极度痴迷。

observations.description: 战斗系统仍然只是互扇耳光式的浅薄设计
observations.evidence: Combat in general is still just slap fighting
observations.evidence_zh: 战斗总体来说仍然只是互扇耳光

items.text:
Seriousely hate the wear and tear mechanics on ship parts like floors/walls and conduits. I get that devs want to add a bit of immersion and that’s all fine when it comes to thrusters wearing down, batteries degrading over time (IRL around 6 to 7 years) and what not. But an entire ship that’s wearing down like it’s constantly been shot at by buck-shot???

Even the ISS doesn’t suffer the kind of structural beating ship hulls do. This is rediculous. I need to completely service my ship in between salvage runs. 

This is just retarded, and i’m in my starter ship. How the hell are you going to keep a larger ship in flying order. Let me guess,… hire a crew of FIVE and set them to permanent maintenance dute???

This devellopement of Ostramauts has not been for the better since i got it fresh out of launch.
items.text_zh:
真的非常讨厌飞船部件如地板/墙壁和管道的磨损机制。我明白开发者想增加一点沉浸感，当涉及到推进器磨损、电池随时间退化（现实中大约6到7年）之类的，这都没问题。但整艘飞船像被霰弹枪不断射击一样磨损？？？

就连国际空间站也没有遭受船体那种结构性的打击。这太荒谬了。我需要在每次打捞任务之间对飞船进行全面维护。

这简直太蠢了，而且我还在用初始飞船。你到底要怎么让一艘更大的飞船保持飞行状态。让我猜猜，……雇五个船员并让他们永久执行维护任务？？？

自从我一开始拿到Ostramauts以来，它的开发并没有变得更好。

observations.description: 飞船部件磨损过快，每次打捞后都需全面维修
observations.evidence: I need to completely service my ship in between salvage runs.
observations.evidence_zh: 我需要在每次打捞任务之间对我的飞船进行全面维护。

items.text: for the time being ill give a thumbs up. that being said if you played neo scavangers you know most of what your getting into. the concept is refreshing and good potential. (yeah how many times have you read that for a early access game). you make some choices of how you character came to be a Scav/wrecker, which matters, from which like all people going out into the world they took on a mortage and bought a ship. the ship and everything in the universe break down and need repairing. salvaging is mostly straight forward, currently a bit difficult in finding leaks, along with getting the money you need to not become a reprobate.
items.text_zh: 暂时我会给个好评。话虽如此，如果你玩过《新拾荒者》，你就知道大部分内容会是什么样。这个概念很清新，潜力也不错。（是啊，你为抢先体验游戏读过多少次这种话了。）你会对角色如何成为拾荒者/拆解者做出一些选择，这些选择很重要，就像所有走向世界的人一样，他们背了房贷并买了一艘船。船以及宇宙中的一切都会损坏，需要修理。打捞基本上很直接，目前找漏点有点困难，同时还要赚到足够的钱，以免沦为堕落之徒。

observations.description: 赚钱困难
observations.evidence: getting the money you need to not become a reprobate
observations.evidence_zh: 赚到足够的钱以免沦为堕落之徒

items.text:
Game is rough, repetitive and wonky as all get out but it hasn't stopped me from enjoying 20+ hours of it. Getting the hang of things at first takes a bit but once you figure it out you'll be looting derelicts and building your own ship ez pz.

Just watch out for the mystery meat.
And grumpy pirates.
items.text_zh:
游戏粗糙、重复，而且笨拙得不能再笨拙，但这并没有阻止我享受20多个小时的游戏时光。一开始上手需要一点时间，但一旦你搞明白了，你就能轻松地打捞废弃飞船并建造自己的飞船。

只要小心那神秘的肉。
还有脾气暴躁的海盗。

observations.description: 游戏重复
observations.evidence: Game is rough, repetitive and wonky as all get out
observations.evidence_zh: 游戏粗糙、重复，而且别扭得要命

items.text:
Fantastic game if you are looking for something a little slower pace, I love how every wreck is a little different and how satisfying it feels looking at your ship loaded to the brim with salvage. Also has some surprisingly tense moments (like when I had to quickly abandon a derelict I was working on before an NPC ship slammed into us going mach 5, keep your proximity alarm on). 

It is an early access game and some game play mechanics feel pretty clunky such as the combat/social system but it has its own kind of strange charm to it. I also find it doesn't interfere too much with the main game for me. 

There have been some bugs but nothing major or game breaking. (At least in my experience) It's still in development so if bugs really bother you it would be wise to give this a little more time to cook.  

This game doesn't really explain much to you when you are first starting out, but once you are over that learning curve it is a ton of fun.

items.text:
I started my playthrough broke as hell, with a ship littered with trash and numerous systems in disrepair. I didn't have time to fix anything though, the clock was ticking and I had a mortgage to pay, so I hopped in that baby and haphazardly darted towards the nearest derelict ship I could see floating in space. 

I docked "successfully" (almost killing myself in the process), put on my spacesuit and headed inside to be greeted by a dead body laying on a bed. After examining the body and determining that this particular spacer had been poisoned to death, I began the demanding task of searching the ship for valuables. I found most systems completely intact and by the grace of god I discover that the reactor was still in good working order. After several hours in game and playing some inventory tetris on my half destroyed ship, I had loaded up on valuables and headed back to the station for my first big payday.

Once back on the station I paid a visit to my black market friend in the local bar, who didn't want my reactor but was very keen on getting her hands on the nav station I had pulled and paid me a little over $10,000, which was more than quadruple the amount of money I had to my name at that point. With those funds I went and bought a proper license from the authorities (all my actions up to this point having been incredibly illegal) and began hauling scrap to the kiosk to be sold. Altogether I found myself with about $80,000 and was able to sigh a breath of relief for the first time since starting the game. 

With a bank account flush with funds and bankruptcy no longer looming over my head, I was able to finally cleanup and fully repair my ship. Additionally, I was able to invest in some better tools along with some bins and lockers to increase my overall inventory space, and once everything was installed I couldn't resist feeling a tinge of pride about how well everything had came together.

I then spent an entire playthrough scrapping ships out in the great unknown, slowing accumulating funds, paying off my mortgage and having numerous close calls with death along the way. Sometimes there would be pirates I would panically burn to death with my laser welder, other times the power of the derelict ship I was salvaging would shut off and I would find myself locked in, several powerless doors away from functioning life support systems as the CO2 indicator on my helmet began flashing.

Ostranauts is amazing in its delivery. It hits exceptionally well and I found it to be some of the most fun I've had playing a game in a very long time. I ended my playthrough once I bought the rights to a mostly functional freighter I had discovered while scavenging that only needed a swapped O2 tank, and fully pimping it out to the nines. My mortgage had been paid off, I had luxurious living quarters, and my ship could haul the scrap from more than a half dozen scavenged ships at a time. My character could functionally retire and live the rest of their life doing the odd scrap job and chilling out in the lap of luxury: I had made it.

I loved every minute of my playthrough and left feeling satisfied but sad that there was really nothing else to do. This would be my only gripe with Ostranauts; the early and mid game are phenomenal but as of right now there is a severe lack of end game content or any excuses to keep a game going. Perhaps I'm greedy, but with such gripping gameplay I just wanted more. Maybe increased difficulty options would help, along with more options during character creation that would allow for more varied playthroughs.

With this game being early access, I hope that it only continues to get better. It's a little bit janky in some areas (particularly the social system) but I have thoroughly enjoyed it and recommend this to anyone looking for a roleplaying experience that's unique, challenging and rewarding.
items.text_zh:
我开局时穷得叮当响，飞船里垃圾遍地，无数系统都处于失修状态。但我没时间修任何东西，时钟在滴答作响，我还有房贷要还，所以我跳上那宝贝，胡乱地朝太空中我能看到的最远的废弃飞船冲去。

我“成功”对接了（差点在这个过程中把自己弄死），穿上宇航服，走进去，迎面看到一具尸体躺在床上。检查了尸体并确定这个太空人死于中毒后，我开始了在飞船上搜寻贵重物品这项艰巨任务。我发现大部分系统完好无损，而且天赐良机，我发现反应堆仍然运转良好。在游戏里过了几个小时后，在我那半毁的飞船上玩了几轮库存俄罗斯方块，我装满了贵重物品，返回空间站，迎来了我的第一笔大收入。

回到空间站后，我去当地酒吧拜访了我的黑市朋友，她不想要我的反应堆，但非常想得到我拆下来的导航站，付了我一万多美元，这比当时我名下所有钱还多四倍以上。有了这些资金，我去当局那里买了一份正规执照（在此之前我的所有行为都极其非法），然后开始把废料运到售货亭出售。总之，我发现自己有了大约八万美元，自开始游戏以来第一次松了一口气。

银行账户资金充裕，破产不再笼罩在我头上，我终于能够清理并全面修复我的飞船。此外，我还投资了一些更好的工具，以及一些箱子和储物柜来增加我的总库存空间，一切安装完毕后，我忍不住为一切组合得如此之好而感到一丝自豪。

然后我花了整整一个周目在浩瀚未知中拆解飞船，慢慢积累资金，还清房贷，一路上无数次与死亡擦肩而过。有时会有海盗，我会惊慌失措地用激光焊枪把他们烧死；其他时候，我正在打捞的废弃飞船会断电，我发现自己被困在里面，隔着几扇没电的门才能到达正常运转的生命维持系统，而头盔上的二氧化碳指示器开始闪烁。

Ostranauts 的表现令人惊叹。它极其出色，我发现这是我很久以来玩过的最有趣的游戏之一。当我买下我在拾荒时发现的一艘基本能用的货船的权利后，我结束了这个周目，那艘船只需要换一个氧气罐，然后我把它彻底改装到极致。我的房贷已经还清，我有豪华的生活区，我的飞船一次可以运载超过六艘打捞飞船的废料。我的角色实际上可以退休，余生做点零星的废料工作，在奢华安逸中享受生活：我成功了。

我热爱我游玩过程中的每一分钟，结束时感到满足，但也难过，因为真的没有其他事情可做了。这将是我对 Ostranauts 唯一的抱怨；前期和中期游戏非常出色，但就目前而言，严重缺乏终局内容或任何让游戏继续下去的理由。也许我贪心，但面对如此引人入胜的玩法，我只想要更多。也许增加难度选项会有所帮助，再加上角色创建时更多选项，能带来更多样化的游玩体验。

由于这款游戏处于抢先体验阶段，我希望它只会越来越好。它在某些方面有点粗糙（尤其是社交系统），但我非常享受，并推荐给任何寻找独特、有挑战性且有回报的角色扮演体验的人。


以及在角色创建时提供更多选项，从而实现更多样化的游玩流程。

由于这款游戏处于抢先体验阶段，我希望它只会变得越来越好。它在某些方面有点粗糙（尤其是社交系统），但我非常享受它，并推荐给任何寻找独特、富有挑战性和回报丰厚的角色扮演体验的人。

items.text:
I consider myself a fan of Neo Scavenger, the previous title by this developer and purchased this with the knowledge that it was in the same universe and presumably of interest to me.

While I am fully aware of the early access state of this game, I found the menus clunky, character creation seemed lacklustre in crafting an appearance: The pronouns don't seem to have any bearing on your actual body physique unless my vision is going, the mirror being scratched up and covered in graffiti is a killer aesthetic touch, but doesn't really help when I'm trying to get a feel for my look, and cycling through each option instead of say, a dropdown menu or even just having a name tied to each option.  and the history system felt like a step down from how you could select traits in Neo-Scavenger.  I understand the value of making the process more immersive but I was given less information for a greater range of skills, traits, and qualities.

The gameplay itself seems promising at first, and I was giddy to go out and salvage. There's a solid introduction to spaceflight that feels convincing, the ambience of your ship creaking as it accelerates was very on point. Picking through derelicts for scrap to pawn off and keep ahead of your payments helps sell the grind, even if I feel like a headless chicken running around trying to hawk my goods at the varied terminals... but the more time I spent messing around on a ship, ripping pieces out and hauling them back to my own, the less confident I felt in the actual gameplay loop. Sure, I've got a general goal and eventually I might stumble into something more tangible down the line, but as it stands it just doesn't click with me.

May revisit upon reaching a full release.
items.text_zh:
我认为自己是Neo Scavenger的粉丝，那是这位开发者之前的作品，我在购买这款游戏时就知道它处于同一个宇宙，想必会让我感兴趣。

虽然我完全清楚这款游戏处于抢先体验阶段，但我发现菜单很笨拙，角色创建在塑造外观方面似乎很乏味：除非我的视力出了问题，代词似乎对你的实际体型没有任何影响，镜子被刮花并涂满涂鸦是一种绝妙的审美点缀，但当我试图感受自己的外观时，它并没有真正帮上忙，而且每个选项都要循环切换，而不是比如下拉菜单，甚至只是给每个选项配一个名称。历史系统感觉比Neo-Scavenger中可以选择特质的方式退步了。我理解让这个过程更具沉浸感的价值，但我为更广泛的技能、特质和品质范围获得的信息却更少了。

游戏玩法本身起初看起来很有前景，我兴奋地想要出去打捞。对太空飞行有一个扎实的介绍，感觉很有说服力，飞船加速时吱嘎作响的氛围非常到位。在废弃飞船中翻找废料去典当，以跟上还款进度，有助于营造那种苦干的感觉，即使我觉得自己像一只无头苍蝇一样四处奔波，试图在各种各样的终端上兜售我的货物……但我在飞船上折腾、拆下部件并搬回自己船上的时间越多，我对实际游戏循环就越没信心。当然，我有一个总体目标，最终也许我会偶然遇到更实在的东西，但就目前而言，它就是不对我的胃口。

等正式发布后可能会再回来看看。

Find derelict that holds pressure, transfers all systems from current ship, discovers the console "new" ship is locked until derelict is purchased at the ship broker. Go to ship broker, they want $300k for (now fixed up) derelict. Reload to before fixed: now $50k, almost all i got, but ok. Go back  and fix up ship (again) get it all the way fixed up, but transponder won't work (broken start) can't fix, can't dock without transponder.  Reload to where ship bought, can't afford transponder, have to go scrap another ship. Now going back to fix derelict for 3rd time. 

Yes, my kindergarten report card had a comment to the  effect of "has trouble reading and following directions" thanks for asking.

Would do again. 
At least it's not as hard core as neoscavenger!

找到一艘能保持压力的废弃飞船，把当前飞船的所有系统转移过去，却发现控制台显示这艘“新”飞船被锁定，直到在飞船经纪人那里购买这艘废弃飞船为止。去找飞船经纪人，他们要为（现在已经修好的）废弃飞船开价30万美元。读档回到修好之前：现在只要5万，几乎是我所有的钱了，但还行。回去（再次）修好飞船，把它一路修到完全修好，但应答器不工作（开局就是坏的），修不了，没有应答器就不能停靠。读档回到买飞船的时候，买不起应答器，只能去拆另一艘船。现在要第三次回去修那艘废弃飞船了。

是的，我幼儿园的成绩单上有一条评语，大意是“在阅读和听从指令方面有困难”，谢谢关心。

还会再这么干。
至少它不像《新拾荒者》那么硬核！

items.text:
I didn't really go into this expecting much, but I did expect there would be some interesting ideas and systems in the game. On the plus side, they have some nice sound effects and a few cool interface panels like the ones you use for the reactor, flight control, coms, etc.

Unfortunately that's pretty much where the pros end. Is there shipbuilding? yes. Are there deep shipbuilding systems? no. There's no circuits or logic, no pipes or anything interesting in this ships at all really. Place your doors, walls, floors, various devices and such, hook them up to power and your done. Atmosphere is nothing more than pump -> canister.

There are some rpg elements, there's an absolutely awful social interaction system that manages to take all the worst traits from other games and make it about 5x worse. Movement is click to move, and it feels terrible. Aside from a few panels, the UI is absolute garbage lacking even obvious basics. For example if you right click on an object to interact with it, a menu comes up at the bottom of the screen instead of near the item, so you move your mouse all the way down there to select, and likely scroll, through various options. The most common options are numbered, but those numbers are not guaranteed to be the same for the same interaction. So you have to actually look each time, lest you disassemble, when you intended to repair.

There are some primordial colony-esque  features to help salvage and sell more quickly.

There just isn't much to this game, and what is here with very few exceptions, is in an extremely rough state.
items.text_zh:
我本来没抱太大期望，但我确实期望游戏里会有一些有趣的想法和系统。好的一面是，他们有一些不错的音效和几个很酷的界面面板，比如用于反应堆、飞行控制、通讯等的那些。

不幸的是，优点基本上就到此为止了。有造船吗？有。有深度的造船系统吗？没有。飞船里根本没有电路或逻辑，没有管道或任何真正有趣的东西。放置你的门、墙、地板、各种设备等等，把它们接上电源就完事了。大气系统不过是泵 -> 罐子。

有一些RPG元素，还有一个绝对糟糕的社交互动系统，它成功地把其他游戏里所有最糟糕的特点都拿了过来，还让它们大约糟糕了5倍。移动是点击移动，感觉糟透了。除了少数几个面板，UI完全是垃圾，连明显的基础功能都缺失。例如，如果你右键点击一个物体与之互动，菜单会出现在屏幕底部而不是物品附近，所以你得把鼠标一路移到下面去选择，而且很可能还要滚动浏览各种选项。最常见的选项是带编号的，但这些编号并不保证对同一种互动是相同的。所以你每次都得实际看一眼，免得你想修理时却把它拆解了。

有一些原始殖民地式的功能，帮助更快地打捞和出售。

这款游戏的内容实在不多，而这里有的东西，除了极少数例外，都处于极其粗糙的状态。
